title: Disentangling Latent Risk Pathways via Bayesian Hypergraph Inference
summary: Electronic health records (EHR) pose large-scale multi-disease modeling problems in which many outcomes are rare and strongly influenced by shared risk factors. While modern approaches achieve strong predictive performance, they often treat diseases independently or rely on black-box architectures, offering limited insight into how risk factors organize disease risk and little principled uncertainty quantification. We introduce a Bayesian hypergraph inference framework that reframes multi-disease modeling around latent, risk-factor-modulated disease pathways. Risk factors act on hyperedges, latent disease subsets with shared risk patterns, allowing diseases to participate in multiple distinct pathways and enabling interpretable, higher-order structure beyond pairwise associations. A repulsion prior encourages parsimonious and identifiable structure, while posterior inference provides calibrated uncertainty over both disease groupings and risk-factor influence. To enable scalable inference on large EHR datasets, we develop a structured variational inference algorithm that preserves logical dependencies among hyperedge existence, disease membership, and pathway-level effects. Experiments on simulated data and UK Biobank demonstrate stable and interpretable disease pathway structure, well-calibrated uncertainty, improved estimation for rare diseases, and competitive predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种贝叶斯超图推断框架，将多疾病建模重构为基于潜在风险因子调节的疾病通路。通过超边（疾病子集）捕获高阶、可解释的疾病风险结构，利用排斥先验实现精简识别，并通过结构化变分推断实现大规模EHR数据上的可扩展推理。在模拟和UK Biobank数据上展示了可解释的疾病通路、校准良好的不确定性、对罕见病的改进估计以及有竞争力的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EHR多疾病建模方法要么独立处理疾病，要么依赖黑盒架构，无法揭示风险因子如何组织疾病风险，也缺乏原则性的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 贝叶斯超图推断框架：风险因子作用于超边（疾病子集），疾病可参与多条通路；引入排斥先验保证结构简洁可识别；设计结构化变分推断算法，保持超边存在性、疾病隶属关系与通路层面效应之间的逻辑依赖关系。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和UK Biobank上：疾病通路结构稳定可解释；不确定性校准良好；罕见病估计改善；预测性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多疾病建模提供了兼具可解释性、不确定性量化与可扩展性的新范式，尤其对罕见病建模有显著优势。

title: Transfer learning for causal forest
summary: Transfer learning addresses the challenge of transfering knowledge from one domain to another. Traditional transfer learning focuses on adapting models trained on a source domain (with a lot of observations) to improve performance on a target domain (with few observations). In this work we consider the case of a model shift and we focus on the transfer learning applied to a causal forest namely HTERF. This causal forest aims to estimate the Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE). The approach considered is the offset method presented by Wang (2016) adapted to a causal context. This method relies on the use of intermediate models in order to estimate the offset between source and target distributions. Our main result is a bound on the CATE error of HTERF on target depending on the error of the intermediate models. Simulation studies show the good performances of this approach in different settings on simulations and on a real-world dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于偏移量方法的迁移学习策略，用于因果森林HTERF在源域与目标域模型偏移情况下估计条件平均处理效应（CATE），并给出了目标域CATE误差的界，通过仿真和真实数据验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统迁移学习主要关注通过源域（数据充足）提升目标域（数据稀缺）的性能，但现有工作较少考虑模型偏移场景下因果森林的迁移学习问题，尤其是CATE估计的误差控制。
AI.method: 采用Wang (2016)提出的偏移量方法（offset method）并适配到因果上下文，通过中间模型估计源域与目标域分布之间的偏移量，将偏移量信息嵌入HTERF因果森林中。
AI.result: 推导出目标域上CATE估计误差的上界，该上界依赖于中间模型的误差；仿真实验和真实数据集上的结果表明该方法在不同设定下均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的偏移量迁移学习方法能有效处理因果森林在模型偏移场景下的CATE估计问题，并具有理论保证和良好的实证表现。

title: Identifiability and Estimation for Unlabeled Finite Mixtures under Marginal Independence
summary: We study component recovery and mixing-matrix estimation from unlabeled finite mixtures whose observable distributions share the same latent components but have unknown mixing weights. The main identifying signal is marginal independence: each component is assumed to be independent on at least one coordinate pair, but no labels, clean component samples, or mixing weights are observed. We first prove a structural result for product components: under linear independence of the univariate marginals, any independent affine combination of the components must coincide with a single component. We then extend this principle to observable mixtures and show that, under full-rank and no-cancellation conditions, marginally independent affine combinations recover the corresponding latent components. When every component is independent on some coordinate pair, all components are identifiable, and the mixing matrix is recoverable under the stated completion conditions. Finally, we propose a Product-Marginal Maximum Mean Discrepancy (PM-MMD) estimator over affine combinations of the observable mixtures and prove uniform convergence and stability under approximate marginal independence. This framework also separates the empirical roles of the assumptions: irreducibility is, in general, not directly testable from the unlabeled mixtures alone, whereas marginal independence yields a candidate-level diagnostic through held-out PM-MMD. Controlled and flow-cytometry experiments show when marginal independence provides a useful recovery signal. In the reported multi-component comparisons, condition-aware representative selection stabilizes PM-MMD and improves recovery relative to clustering, factorization, and pairwise mixture-proportion baselines using the same unlabeled mixtures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从未标记的有限混合分布中恢复成分和混合矩阵的问题，利用边缘独立性作为识别信号，提出了基于乘积边缘最大均值差异（PM-MMD）的估计方法，并从理论和实验上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 在无标签、无干净成分样本、未知混合权重的设定下，如何从未标记的混合分布中识别和恢复潜在成分是一个具有挑战性的问题。传统方法依赖于可逆性或足够不同的混合权重，而本文探索利用边缘独立性这一更弱的假设来实现成分恢复。
AI.method: 1. 证明了一个关于乘积成分的结构性结果：在线性独立的单变量边际条件下，任何独立仿射组合必须与单个成分重合。2. 将这一原理扩展到可观测混合分布，证明在满秩和无抵消条件下，边缘独立的仿射组合能恢复对应的潜在成分。3. 提出了PM-MMD估计器，对可观测混合的仿射组合进行优化，并证明了在近似边缘独立条件下的一致收敛性和稳定性。
AI.result: 当每个成分在某个坐标对上独立时，所有成分都是可识别的，且在所述完备条件下混合矩阵可恢复。该方法将假设的角色分离：不可约性通常无法直接从无标签混合物中检验，而边缘独立性可通过留出PM-MMD提供候选级诊断。受控实验和流式细胞实验表明边缘独立性能提供有用的恢复信号。在多成分比较中，条件感知的代表性选择稳定了PM-MMD，并相对于聚类、分解和成对混合比例基线方法提升了恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 边缘独立性作为识别信号在无标签混合分布的成分恢复中是有效的，PM-MMD框架提供了可实现的估计方法，并在实验中优于传统基线方法。

title: Barycentric Projections of Optimal Transport Plans on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Optimal transport couplings are probabilistic objects, while many learning pipelines require deterministic maps. In Euclidean space, barycentric projection converts a coupling into a map by taking conditional expectations, but on a Riemannian manifold curvature and cut loci make this operation nontrivial. We develop a framework for barycentric projections of transport couplings on Riemannian manifolds. The intrinsic projection maps each source point to the conditional Fréchet mean of its destination law and is shown to be the best deterministic representative under squared geodesic loss. The corresponding minimum value is an integrated conditional Fréchet variance, which vanishes exactly for map-induced couplings and therefore defines a conditional-variance Monge defect. We also study a tangential log-exp projection, prove its Euclidean exactness, its compatibility with Brenier-McCann maps in the Monge case, and its interpretation as the first unit Riemannian gradient update for the intrinsic objective. For discrete couplings, both constructions decompose row-wise into weighted Fréchet mean and log-exp problems. Experiments on spherical data, synthetic SPD data, and real EEG covariance matrices support the proposed division of roles: the intrinsic projection is the variational representative, while the tangential projection is a useful local displacement surrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文在黎曼流形上发展了最优传输耦合的 barycentric 投影框架，将欧氏空间中的条件期望推广为条件 Fréchet 均值，并定义了条件方差 Monge 缺陷；同时提出了切向 log-exp 投影，证明了其在 Monge 情形下与 Brenier-McCann 映射的兼容性；在球面、合成 SPD 数据和真实 EEG 协方差矩阵上验证了两种投影的不同作用。
AI.motivation: 最优传输耦合是概率性对象，而许多学习流程需要确定性映射。在欧氏空间中可通过 barycentric 投影（条件期望）将耦合转化为映射，但黎曼流形上的曲率和割迹使这一操作变得非平凡，因此需要发展适用于流形的框架。
AI.method: 1) 内在投影：将每个源点映射到其目标分布的条件 Fréchet 均值，证明其为平方测地线损失下的最优确定性代表，对应的最小值为集成条件 Fréchet 方差（定义为条件方差 Monge 缺陷）；2) 切向 log-exp 投影：证明其在欧氏空间中的精确性、与 Brenier-McCann 映射的兼容性，并解释为内在目标函数的第一个单位黎曼梯度更新。对离散耦合，两种构造都分解为逐行的加权 Fréchet 均值和 log-exp 问题。
AI.result: 内在投影是变分代表，切向投影是局部位移替代。在球面数据、合成 SPD 数据和真实 EEG 协方差矩阵上的实验验证了上述角色分工。
AI.conclusion: 建立了黎曼流形上最优传输耦合的确定性映射框架，为流形上的学习任务提供了理论保证和实用工具。

title: Large-time behavior and accuracy of the Mean-Field Ensemble Kalman Filter in the Linear Detectable Setting
summary: The ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF), originally developed in the geophysical sciences, is now widely used for state and parameter estimation problems in various domains of application. It may be viewed as a robust, cheap-to-implement, alternative to the optimal, Bayesian, filter. However, despite its empirical successes, theoretical understanding of its properties, in relation to the optimal filter, is in its infancy. In this paper we contribute novel theoretical understanding, studying the behavior of the mean-field limit of the ensemble Kalman filter (MFEnKF) in the linear setting. In this setting the MFEnKF coincides with the Kalman filter itself, for Gaussian initial data. We study the MFEnKF with general, non-Gaussian, initial data. Under the assumptions of nondegeneracy of the signal noise and detectability of the signal-observation pair we make three specific contributions. First, we derive the MFEnKF via a variational approximation of the Bayes update using a covariance-weighted optimal transport metric. Secondly, we use this metric to show that the MFEnKF is a strict contraction towards the subspace of Gaussian measures, giving explicit geometric rates in terms of the covariances, in both discrete and continuous time. Finally, in the continuous-time setting, we deduce a stable form of almost sure accuracy of the MFEnKF: given any pair of (nondegenerate) initial data for the MFEnKF and the optimal filter, any uniformly continuous moments of the two filtering distributions coincide in large time, for almost every observation path.

AI.tldr: 本文在非高斯初始数据条件下，理论分析了线性设定中平均场极限集合卡尔曼滤波（MFEnKF）的性质，证明其通过变分逼近贝叶斯更新实现向高斯测度子空间的严格收缩，并给出显式几何速率；在连续时间下，证明了MFEnKF与最优滤波器的均匀连续矩在长时间下几乎必然一致。
AI.motivation: 尽管集合卡尔曼滤波（EnKF）在应用中取得了广泛成功，但其相对于最优贝叶斯滤波的理论性质尚处于初级阶段。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，通过研究平均场极限下的EnKF（MFEnKF）在非高斯初始条件下的行为，建立其与最优滤波器之间的严格理论联系。
AI.method: 在信号噪声非退化及信号-观测对可检测的假设下，本文首先通过协方差加权最优传输度量下的贝叶斯更新变分逼近推导MFEnKF；随后利用该度量证明MFEnKF向高斯测度子空间的严格收缩，给出离散与连续时间下关于协方差的显式几何速率；最后在连续时间框架下建立MFEnKF与最优滤波器之间均匀连续矩的长时间几乎必然一致性。
AI.result: （1）MFEnKF可以通过协方差加权最优传输度量下的变分贝叶斯更新推导得到；（2）MFEnKF以显式几何速率向高斯测度子空间严格收缩；（3）在连续时间下，对任意非退化初始数据，MFEnKF与最优滤波器的任意均匀连续矩在长时间下几乎处处一致。
AI.conclusion: 在线性设定下，即使初始数据非高斯，MFEnKF仍能以指数级速率收敛到高斯子空间，且长期行为与最优滤波器在矩意义上几乎必然一致，这为EnKF的理论合理性提供了重要支撑。

title: PathoSage: Towards Multi-Source Evidence Adjudication in Pathology via Experience-Aware Agentic Workflow
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and agent workflows have shown strong promise for computational pathology, yet reliable patch-level reasoning remains challenging. End-to-end pathology MLLMs often hallucinate morphological features, while recent agentic systems usually merge tool outputs and retrieved knowledge into a shared context, making decisions vulnerable to conflicting evidence and context contamination. We propose PathoSage, a three-stage framework that explicitly separates knowledge retrieval, evidence collection, and evidence adjudication for patch-level pathology multimodal reasoning. Its core component, Structured Evidence Deliberation, independently evaluates heterogeneous evidence from tools, performs conflict analysis, and generates the final judgment in a fresh context to reduce anchoring bias. We further introduce a training-free Beta-Bernoulli experience system with continuous credit assignment to model long-term tool reliability and construct similarity-weighted priors for future tool use. Experiments show that PathoSage effectively mitigates VQA hallucinations and classifier disagreement, outperforming strong pathology MLLM and agentic baselines. Our results highlight explicit evidence adjudication and reliability-aware tool modeling as key ingredients for robust pathology agents.

AI.tldr: PathoSage是一个三阶段框架，通过显式分离知识检索、证据收集和证据裁决，并结合Beta-Bernoulli经验系统建模工具长期可靠性，有效缓解病理MLLM中的幻觉和分类器分歧问题。
AI.motivation: 现有病理多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在补丁级推理中容易出现形态学特征幻觉，而现有的代理系统将工具输出和检索知识合并到共享上下文中，导致决策易受冲突证据和上下文污染影响，缺乏可靠的证据裁决机制。
AI.method: 提出PathoSage三阶段框架：(1) 知识检索、证据收集与证据裁决显式分离；(2) 核心组件"结构化证据裁决"独立评估来自工具的异构证据，进行冲突分析，并在全新上下文中生成最终判断以减少锚定偏差；(3) 引入免训练的Beta-Bernoulli经验系统，通过连续信用分配建模工具长期可靠性，构建基于相似性加权的先验用于未来工具选择。
AI.result: 实验表明PathoSage有效缓解了VQA幻觉和分类器分歧问题，在多种病理MLLM和代理基线方法上取得了更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式的证据裁决机制和可靠性感知的工具建模是构建鲁棒病理代理的关键要素。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion: Codebase and Benchmark
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route for developing plasma controllers from historical tokamak data, since online trial-and-error on real devices is costly and risky. However, progress in this direction remains difficult to measure due to the lack of a standardized offline RL benchmark for realistic multi-actuator, long-horizon plasma control problems in nuclear fusion. We introduce RL4F, an Offline Reinforcement Learning Benchmark for Plasma Control in Nuclear Fusion, providing closed-loop evaluation environments and baseline comparisons across four full-profile tracking tasks: rotation, density, temperature, and pressure. The dynamics function underlying the evaluation environment is built from historical discharge data from DIII-D, a real-world Tokamak. We evaluate a broad set of imitation learning and offline RL baselines under a unified protocol. We find that offline model-based RL methods obtain the best average performance on most objectives, although no single method dominates all tasks, highlighting the importance of dynamics modeling in complex, long-horizon plasma control tasks. To foster further research, we open-source the codebase, datasets, and evaluation framework, providing a benchmark not only for the fusion community but also for algorithm development in offline RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RL4F，一个面向核聚变等离子体控制的离线强化学习基准，包含基于DIII-D托卡马克历史数据的闭环评估环境和四种全廓线跟踪任务（旋转、密度、温度、压力）。实验表明离线基于模型的方法平均表现最优，但无单一方法在所有任务中占优，强调了动力学建模在长时域等离子体控制中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习为从历史托卡马克数据开发等离子体控制器提供了有前景的途径，因为在线试错成本高且风险大。然而，由于缺乏针对多执行器、长时域等离子体控制问题的标准化离线RL基准，难以衡量该方向的进展。
AI.method: 构建了基于DIII-D真实托卡马克历史放电数据的动力学模型作为评估环境，设计了旋转、密度、温度、压力四种全廓线跟踪任务，统一协议下评估了多种模仿学习和离线RL基线方法。
AI.result: 离线基于模型的RL方法在多数目标上取得最佳平均性能，但没有任何单一方法在所有任务中占优。
AI.conclusion: 动力学建模在复杂长时域等离子体控制任务中至关重要；RL4F为核聚变社区和离线RL算法开发提供了标准化基准，相关代码、数据和评估框架已开源。

title: Variational Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback via Proximal Policy Optimization often suffers from policy mode collapse, brittle exploration loops, and distribution drift. This paper introduces Variational Proximal Policy Optimization (\(\textsc{VP}_2\textsc{O}\)), a particle-based variational inference framework that maps policy optimization to Stein Variational Gradient Descent within a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. By leveraging functional kernels over localized expert prototypes alongside an expert orthogonalization loss, \(\textsc{VP}_2\textsc{O}\) introduces a geometry-based proximal-control mechanism that can reduce reliance on fixed clipping or KL schedules. Our results on a 33B/4B sparse Mixture-of-Experts model show several improvements across complex reasoning benchmarks, establishing a \(+\mathbf{179}\) ELO gain on Codeforces and a \(\mathbf{32\%}\) reduction in token count on AIME mathematical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VP₂O，一种基于粒子变分推断的强化学习框架，通过 Stein 变分梯度下降与混合专家架构，在 33B/4B 稀疏 MoE 模型上实现了 Codeforces +179 ELO 提升和 AIME 数学推理 32% 的 token 削减，缓解了 PPO 的策略模式坍缩与分布漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 标准 RLHF/PPO 训练存在策略模式坍缩（policy mode collapse）、脆弱的探索循环（brittle exploration loops）以及分布漂移（distribution drift），需要更鲁棒的约束机制。
AI.method: 将策略优化映射为 Stein 变分梯度下降（SVGD）在 Mixture-of-Experts 架构中的粒子变分推断过程；使用基于局部专家原型的函数核（functional kernels）并引入专家正交化损失（expert orthogonalization loss）；以几何驱动的近端控制机制替代固定裁剪或 KL 调度。
AI.result: 在 33B/4B 稀疏 MoE 模型上，Codeforces 提升 +179 ELO，AIME 数学推理任务 token 消耗降低 32%。
AI.conclusion: VP₂O 通过几何近端控制有效缓解了 PPO 的分布漂移和模式坍缩问题，在复杂推理任务上取得显著收益。

title: Non-Archimedean Polydisc Spaces and Applications to Optimisation
summary: We propose a new framework for optimisation over non-Archimedean spaces inspired by Berkovich geometry. Specifically, we introduce polydisc spaces, which consists of products of closed balls over a non-Archimedean field. These spaces retain the rigid hierarchical structure of the non-Archimedean field whilst acquiring many desirable geometric features absent from it. We show that metric trees embed naturally into these spaces, demonstrating their capacity to represent hierarchical data. We study their metric geometry, establishing properties such as geodesic uniqueness, confirming their comaptibility with classical optimisation techniques. We further propose a class of real-valued functions given by linear combinations of absolute values of polynomials. These functions admit a piecewise polynomial description along geodesics and satisfy a universal approximation property. We formulate a theory of optimisation on polydisc spaces: we prove existence of minimisers and explore algorithms for finding them. We provide an accompanying open-source Julia library implementing the core objects and optimisation procedures introduced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Berkovich几何的非阿基米德空间优化框架，引入多圆盘空间，证明了其度量几何性质，提出了一类由多项式绝对值线性组合构成的实值函数，并建立了相应的优化理论，同时提供了开源Julia库实现。
AI.motivation: 非阿基米德空间具有严格的层次结构，但缺乏适合优化的几何特征。作者希望构造一种既能保留非阿基米德场的层次结构，又具备良好几何性质的空间，以便在该空间上进行优化。
AI.method: 受Berkovich几何启发，引入由非阿基米德域上闭球的乘积构成的多圆盘空间；研究其度量几何（测地线唯一性等）；提出由多项式绝对值线性组合构成的实值函数类，该函数沿测地线具有分段多项式描述且满足通用逼近性质；建立优化理论（极小值存在性、算法探索）；开发开源Julia库。
AI.result: 证明了度量树可自然嵌入多圆盘空间，建立了测地线唯一性等几何性质，提出的函数类满足通用逼近性质，证明了优化问题中极小值的存在性，并实现了相应的Julia开源库。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将非阿基米德几何与经典优化技术相结合，为层次化数据的优化问题提供了新的理论工具和实用实现。

title: OmniMem: Perturbation-aware Memory Compression for Streaming Audio-Visual LLMs
summary: Audio-visual large language models (LLMs) hold strong promise for long-form video understanding, yet their long-video inference is fundamentally limited by the linear growth of video tokens and key-value (KV) caches. We present OmniMem, a memory-efficient streaming framework designed specifically for audio-visual LLMs. Unlike existing compression methods that treat all tokens uniformly, OmniMem introduces a modality-aware memory allocation strategy that separately manages visual and audio contexts, addressing the severe token imbalance between the two modalities. OmniMem further preserves informative and non-redundant KV states through perturbation-aware memory selection, enabling compact memory without sacrificing long-range understanding. To strengthen compression under realistic deployment constraints, we also explore budget-aware fine-tuning, which encourages the model to consolidate useful information into retained memory. Experiments on VideoMME Long, LVBench, and LVOmniBench with video-SALMONN 2+ and Qwen-2.5-Omni show that OmniMem consistently improves over strong training-free compression baselines by 2-4% absolute accuracy under the same memory budgets, with an additional 1-2% gain after fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: OmniMem是一种针对音视频大语言模型的内存高效流式推理框架，通过模态感知的内存分配策略和扰动感知的选择机制，结合预算感知微调，在相同内存预算下比无训练压缩基线提升2-4%绝对准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频大语言模型在长视频理解中面临视频token和KV缓存线性增长的问题，且已有压缩方法对所有token一视同仁，忽略了视觉和音频模态之间严重的token不平衡。
AI.method: 1) 模态感知的内存分配策略，分别管理视觉和音频上下文；2) 扰动感知的内存选择机制，保留信息丰富且非冗余的KV状态；3) 预算感知微调，鼓励模型将有用信息整合到保留内存中。
AI.result: 在VideoMME Long、LVBench和LVOmniBench基准上，基于video-SALMONN 2+和Qwen-2.5-Omni模型，在相同内存预算下比强无训练压缩基线提升2-4%绝对准确率，微调后额外提升1-2%。
AI.conclusion: OmniMem通过模态感知和扰动感知机制有效解决了音视频LLM长视频推理中的内存瓶颈，验证了预算感知微调对进一步压缩的增益效果。

title: MedicalRec: Medical recommender system for image classification without retraining
summary: The emergence of machine learning and deep learning has revolutionized the efficiency of diagnostic, therapeutic, and administrative systems in healthcare. However, this rapid adoption has come at the cost of requiring significant computing power and energy consumption, as well as e-waste disposal and carbon emissions. One of the challenges of these models is choosing the right model for classification tasks. To this end, researchers attempt to identify the optimal model using their data through trial and error, which involves energy consumption and waste. The goal of this study is to develop a model-based recommender system for medical image classification. For this purpose, a data set was collected from 3,000 articles in the field of medical image classification. This dataset, publicly available under the name MedicalRec-Bench, contains over 5,000 records of models tested in various tasks, including Skin Cancer Classification, Tumour Classification, Wound Classification, Breast Cancer, and MRI classification. The dataset was evaluated in four different modes, depending on the number of features: MedicalRec I (5 features), MedicalRec II (9 features), MedicalRec III (11 features), and MedicalRec IV (18 features). Collecting all values for the features is challenging due to non-reporting by the authors; hence, the dataset contains significant amounts of missing values. The Medical Recommender System (MedicalRec) is a transformer-based model used for item recommendations in this study. This model achieved remarkable results in the evaluation on the dataset and in the evaluation with 12 base models. This model achieved a maximum HitRate@100 of 75.5%. The dataset and implementations are available through the GitHub link: https://github.com/Ramin1Mousa/MedicalRec

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MedicalRec，一个基于Transformer的模型推荐系统，用于在医疗图像分类任务中推荐最优模型，以减少试错带来的能源消耗。基于3000篇论文构建了含5000+条记录的MedicalRec-Bench数据集，模型在四种特征模式下评估，最高HitRate@100达75.5%。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型选择依赖试错法，消耗大量计算资源和能源，产生碳排放与电子垃圾。本文旨在开发一个模型推荐系统，帮助研究者无需反复试验即可找到适合其医疗图像分类任务的最优模型。
AI.method: 从3000篇医疗图像分类论文中提取数据，构建包含5000+条记录的MedicalRec-Bench数据集，涵盖皮肤癌、肿瘤、伤口、乳腺癌、MRI等分类任务。数据集按特征数量分为四个版本（5/9/11/18个特征）。采用基于Transformer的推荐模型MedicalRec进行训练和推荐。
AI.result: MedicalRec在四个数据集版本上均表现优异，在与12个基线的对比评估中达到最高HitRate@100为75.5%。数据集和代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的推荐系统可有效用于医疗图像分类任务的模型选择，减少试错成本与能源消耗，具有良好的实用价值与推广潜力。

title: Beyond Additivity: Causal Discovery in Location-Scale Noise Models with Hidden Variables
summary: We study causal discovery from observational data when some variables are hidden and the data-generating process follows a location-scale noise model (LSNM). Existing methods that handle hidden confounders typically assume additive noise, but in practice, causes often modulate not just the mean but also the variance of their effects. We prove that acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs) satisfying a bow-free condition are identifiable under LSNM with hidden variables, establishing the first identifiability result for causally insufficient models beyond noise additivity. We further provide sufficient conditions for identifying causal direction even when the bow-free assumption is violated. Our two-stage algorithm, LSNM-UV, is sound and complete, and experiments demonstrate improved performance over additive baselines on heteroscedastic data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在位置-尺度噪声模型下，即使存在隐藏变量且不满足弓形无约束条件，有环有向混合图仍然是可识别的，并设计了LSNM-UV算法在异方差数据上优于加性基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果发现方法通常假设加性噪声，但现实中原因往往不仅影响结果的均值，还会调节方差（异方差性）。当存在隐藏变量时，这一问题更加复杂，目前缺乏超越加性噪声假设的因果不可充分性模型的可识别性结果。
AI.method: 理论证明在位置-尺度噪声模型下，满足弓形无约束条件的有环有向混合图是可识别的；并给出弓形无约束条件不满足时识别因果方向的充分条件。基于此设计了LSNM-UV两阶段算法。
AI.result: LSNM-UV算法在异方差数据上性能优于基于加性噪声假设的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 首次建立了超越加性噪声假设的因果不可充分性模型的可识别性结果，为处理异方差性和隐藏混淆变量的因果发现提供了理论基础和实用算法。

title: On the sharp linear convergence rate of the circumcentered--reflection method on subspaces
summary: For two subspaces $U,V\subseteq\RR^n$, the circumcentered--reflection method (CRM) of Behling, Bello-Cruz, and Santos~\cite{BBS2018} computes the projection onto $U\cap V$ using only the reflections across $U$ and $V$, with known linear-convergence rate $c_F$, the cosine of the Friedrichs angle. We prove that, when CRM is initialized in $V$, it contracts at the strictly smaller rate $ρ_V=(\sin^2θ_p-\sin^2θ_F)/(\sin^2θ_p+\sin^2θ_F)$, where $θ_F\in(0,π/2]$ is the Friedrichs angle and $θ_p\in[θ_F,π/2]$ the largest principal angle between $U$ and $V$. The bound is sharp, attained on an explicit ray in $V$, and optimal among parameter-free single-step iterations. The constant itself is not new: Bauschke, Bello-Cruz, Nghia, Phan, and Wang~\cite{BBNPW2016} identified it as the optimal rate of the relaxed alternating-projection family and of their adaptive linesearch map $B_T$. Our contribution is that the parameter-free geometric circumcenter attains it as well, via Kantorovich's inequality applied to a single self-adjoint operator on $V$. Restricted to $V$, CRM coincides pointwise with the linesearch maps $A_T$ and $B_T$ from the Gubin--Polyak--Raik framework~\cite{GPR1967}. We further prove $ρ_V<c_F^2$ whenever $θ_F<π/2$, with one-step convergence exactly when $θ_F=θ_p$. Over-reflecting either or both of $R_U$, $R_V$ inside the circumcenter does not help. Going faster than $ρ_V$ universally requires memory: Chebyshev semi-iteration applied to $P_VP_U$ attains a strictly smaller rate, beating $ρ_V$ by a factor at most $2$, attained in the limit $θ_F\toθ_p$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，当初始化在子空间V中时，环心反射法（CRM）计算到U∩V的投影的收敛率严格小于弗裡德里希斯角的余弦c_F，具体为ρ_V，该率是尖锐的且最优，并与松弛交替投影族及自适应线搜索映射的最优率一致。
AI.motivation: 分析CRM在特定初始化条件下的收敛行为，证明其收敛率优于已知的一般性结果，并建立与现有最优方法之间的联系。
AI.method: 通过应用Kantorovich不等式于V上的单个自伴算子，分析CRM在V中的动态；证明CRM在V中逐点等同于Gubin-Polyak-Raik框架中的线搜索映射A_T和B_T。
AI.result: CRM在V中初始化的收敛率ρ_V = (sin²θ_p - sin²θ_F)/(sin²θ_p + sin²θ_F)，严格小于c_F；该率是尖锐的且最优；当θ_F=θ_p时一步收敛；过度反射不改善；超越ρ_V需要记忆（Chebyshev半迭代可达到更小率）。
AI.conclusion: 参数无关的几何环心法可以达到与现有最优参数化方法相同的收敛率，但进一步提升需要引入记忆机制。

title: Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution
summary: Personal AI agents must increasingly operate across APIs, shells, web surfaces, and desktop GUIs, yet many systems remain tuned to a single interface and offer limited support for user teaching and auditability. We present Syll, an open-source, self-hosted multimodal agent harness that unifies MCP/API tools, CLI execution, and visual GUI control in a modular runtime, enabling agents to coordinate computer use across heterogeneous interfaces while streamlining how users and agents exchange information. At the core of Syll is a bidirectional user-agent interaction layer: users teach procedures through direct demonstration, which Syll compiles into reusable skills; agent execution is translated back into multimodal evidence -- logs, keyframes, and approval checkpoints -- for inspection and control. Syll further externalizes memory, skills, routines, and governance as editable local artifacts, supporting straightforward inspection, extension, and downstream development. Our implementation has been validated on production desktop applications including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Audition, Stardew Valley, macOS Finder and others. We report mechanism-oriented studies that validate multimodal routing, teachable GUI replay, and persistent local artifacts. We hope Syll can serve as a practical open-source foundation for personal automation that users can teach, inspect, and continuously extend.

AI.tldr: Syll是一个开源、自托管的 multimodal agent 框架，统一了 MCP/API 工具、CLI 执行和视觉 GUI 控制，支持双向用户-智能体交互：用户通过演示教学生成可复用技能，智能体执行结果以多模态证据（日志、关键帧、审批检查点）呈现，所有记忆、技能、流程和治理规则均以可编辑的本地工件形式存在，便于用户检查、扩展和下游开发。
AI.motivation: 现有个人 AI agent 系统多局限于单一界面（如仅 API、仅 CLI 或仅 GUI），且缺乏对用户教学和可审计性的支持，无法满足用户对智能体行为进行监督、教学和持续扩展的实际需求。
AI.method: 提出 Syll 框架：1) 模块化运行时统一 MCP/API 工具、CLI 执行和视觉 GUI 控制；2) 双向用户-智能体交互层，用户通过直接演示教学，Syll 将演示编译为可复用技能；3) 智能体执行结果转化为多模态证据（日志、关键帧、审批检查点）供用户审查；4) 外部化记忆、技能、流程和治理规则为可编辑本地工件。
AI.result: 在 Adobe Photoshop、Adobe Audition、Stardew Valley、macOS Finder 等生产级桌面应用中验证了实现效果，并通过面向机制的研究验证了多模态路由、可教学 GUI 回放和持久化本地工件等核心能力。
AI.conclusion: Syll 可作为个人自动化的开源基础框架，支持用户教学、检查和持续扩展个人 AI agent。

title: SPIN: Decentralized Swarm Control via Tensorized Policy Coordination
summary: Decentralized multi-agent swarm coordination on resource-constrained edge platforms remains fundamentally bottlenecked by the exponential scaling of joint action spaces and high-latency communication overhead. This paper introduces the Swarm Policy Interference Network (SPIN) framework, an architectural paradigm that bypasses these limitations by modeling swarm topologies as a compressed tensor network. We factorize the joint policy tensors of local multi-agent cliques into Matrix Product State (MPS) chains, reducing the computational complexity of evaluation from an exponential $O(n^m)$ wall to a strictly linear $O(m \cdot n \cdot χ^2)$ constraint. To bridge local continuous spatial geometry with this discrete algebraic backend without requiring power-intensive online training loops, we introduce a decoupled, hybrid neuro-symbolic control pipeline. Local multi-layered neural networks operate as structural coordination encoders, pre-trained offline to nonlinearly map hand-engineered geometric descriptors into abstract environmental target measures. At runtime, edge agents execute instantaneous behavioral adaptations by applying the Radon-Nikodým derivative directly as a zero-shot importance-reweighting filter. We validate the framework within a discrete-time multi-agent simulation sandbox spanning tracking, decentralized dispersion/area coverage, and multi-goal coordination regimes. Qualitative telemetry demonstrates that the integrated pipeline achieves stable target-directed motion, anti-collapse spatial spreading under decentralized constraints, and structured subgroup formation across multiple targets, providing a mathematically grounded route to tractable, low-power edge swarm intelligence.

AI.tldr: SPIN框架通过张量网络压缩（矩阵乘积态）将多智能体联合策略评估复杂度从指数级降至线性级，并利用离线训练的神经编码器与在线Radon-Nikodým重加权过滤器实现低功耗边缘群体智能。
AI.motivation: 资源受限边缘平台上分布式多智能体群体协调面临两大核心瓶颈：联合动作空间的指数级膨胀，以及高延迟通信开销。
AI.method: 1) 将群体拓扑建模为压缩张量网络，利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）链分解联合策略张量，复杂度降至O(m·n·χ²)；2) 解耦混合神经符号控制管线：离线预训练的局部神经网络（结构协调编码器）将几何描述符映射为目标度量，在线通过Radon-Nikodým导数作为零样本重要性重加权过滤器实现即时行为调整。
AI.result: 在离散时间多智能体仿真沙盒中验证了跟踪、分散/覆盖和多目标协调等场景，定性遥测显示实现了稳定目标导向运动、抗塌缩空间扩散和结构化子群形成。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一条数学上严谨的路径，实现可处理、低功耗的边缘群体智能。

title: Vector Space of Cycles
summary: Most statistical and machine learning methods for directed interactions focus on pairwise effects among variables. Even existing cyclic models represent feedback primarily through node-level dependencies, making large-scale recurrent organization difficult to estimate and compare. This limitation is particularly acute in biological and neural systems, where interactions are highly recurrent and involve many overlapping cycles. We introduce a variational framework for statistical inference on cyclic interactions. Directed interactions are represented as edge flows on a simplicial complex and evolved under an energy-minimizing dynamical system. The resulting dynamics separate transient interaction components from persistent harmonic flows, yielding a low-dimensional cycle space that captures stable recurrent organization. Rather than enumerating individual cycles, the proposed framework represents cyclic interactions as elements of a Hilbert space, enabling projection, averaging, comparison, and population-level statistical inference. We establish theoretical properties of the harmonic projection, including characterization of the cycle space, variance reduction, and population inference. Simulations demonstrate substantially improved recovery of cyclic structure in dense recurrent systems compared with existing directed-interaction methods. Applied to resting-state fMRI from 400 human subjects, the framework reveals reproducible large-scale cyclic organization that is not detectable through edgewise averaging. These results provide a scalable statistical framework for studying recurrent interactions in high-dimensional dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个变分推断框架，将循环交互表示为单纯复形上的边流，通过能量最小化动力学分离出持久谐波流，构建低维循环空间，实现对高维递归系统（如脑网络）中循环结构的统计推断和比较。
AI.motivation: 现有方法和模型主要关注变量间的成对效应，难以估计和比较大规模递归组织，尤其在生物和神经系统中，交互高度递归且涉及大量重叠循环。
AI.method: 将有向交互表示为单纯复形上的边流，通过能量最小化动力学演化，分离瞬态交互成分与持久谐波流；将循环交互表示为希尔伯特空间中的元素，支持投影、平均、比较和群体统计推断。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明，在密集递归系统中，该方法对循环结构的恢复显著优于现有有向交互方法；应用于400名人类受试者的静息态fMRI数据，揭示了可重复的大规模循环组织，这是边平均方法无法检测到的。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高维动力系统中的递归交互研究提供了可扩展的统计方法，能够分离并表征稳定的循环结构。

title: Verification Framework for the Union of Control Barrier Functions
summary: Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) have been proposed to ensure safety of autonomous systems. This paper considers control policies that switch between CBF constraints. Under this approach, we represent a complex non-convex safe region as a union of sets that are computationally tractable to verify. We denote this framework as union-CBFs and make the following contributions. First, considering switching CBF-QP controllers, we propose a sufficient condition that ensures (i) the system undergoes a finite number of switches in any finite time interval and ensures (ii) the forward invariance of the closed-loop system in between switches. Second, we consider two types of switching strategies and propose union-CBFs conditions for each strategy to satisfy (i) and (ii). Third, we formulate Sum-of-Squares (SOS) algorithms to verify the conditions. The experiments show that our union-CBFs framework results in a larger safe region compared to high-degree polynomial CBFs. We also show the efficiency of the verification algorithms using a polynomial system model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的切换控制框架（union-CBFs），将复杂非凸安全区域表示为多个计算上易处理子集的并集，并给出确保有限次切换和闭环正向不变性的充分条件，通过Sum-of-Squares算法进行验证，实验表明该方法相比高阶多项式CBF能获得更大的安全区域。
AI.motivation: 传统CBF方法要求安全区域为凸集或单一高阶多项式描述，难以处理复杂的非凸安全约束。本文旨在通过将非凸安全区域分解为多个易验证子集的并集，在保证安全的前提下扩大可行安全区域。
AI.method: 提出union-CBF框架：将非凸安全区域表示为多个凸（或易处理）子集的并集，设计切换CBF-QP控制器。给出保证有限次切换（无Zeno现象）和开关切换间闭环正向不变性的充分条件。针对两种切换策略分别提出相应的union-CBF条件，并基于Sum-of-Squares（SOS）算法进行条件验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，union-CBF框架相比高阶多项式CBF能够获得更大的安全区域，且SOS验证算法在多项式系统模型上具有高效性。
AI.conclusion: union-CBF通过将复杂安全区域分解为多个子集的并集，结合切换控制策略，有效解决了非凸安全约束下的安全关键控制问题，在扩大安全区域的同时保持了计算可处理性。

title: A case study of evaluating AI agents on a neuroscience data-to-discovery pipeline
summary: Agentic AI tools offer a promising path to automating software development bottlenecks in scientific research pipelines, particularly for stages that take domain experts days to months to build, where scientists care about correctness and robustness, not implementation details. We present an empirical study of general-purpose coding agents on a fly optogenetics data-to-discovery pipeline. We assess agents on tasks substantially larger than existing benchmarks, datasets orders of magnitude bigger, and evaluation criteria grounded in domain expert standards. We show that agents can solve several individual pipeline stages, suggesting stage-level automation is tractable. By analyzing agents' code iterations, we show that they struggle most when there is not a pre-defined criterion to iterate on, and they must instead use their scientific judgment to assess their current solution, a key open challenge. Mirroring scientific practice, they sometimes attempt visual inspection of intermediate outputs for self-evaluation, but largely fail to interpret what they see or act on it appropriately. Solving the end-to-end pipeline correctly requires stringing together successes across all pipeline stages, and this is beyond agents' current abilities. We identify challenges largely absent from existing benchmarks, including computational resource management and generalization to large held-out data collections. Finally, we distill principles for constructing scientific tasks and rigorous evaluation criteria for open-ended problems.

AI.tldr: 本文对通用编程Agent在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流水线中的应用进行了实证研究，发现Agent能解决部分阶段任务，但在需要科学判断自评估、端到端串联、计算资源管理和大规模数据泛化方面面临重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 科研流水线中部分阶段需要领域专家耗时数天至数月，科学家关注正确性和稳健性而非实现细节，Agentic AI工具为自动化这些瓶颈提供了有希望的路径。
AI.method: 在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流水线上对通用编程Agent进行实证研究，评估任务规模远超现有基准，数据集大数个数量级，评价标准基于领域专家标准，并通过分析Agent的代码迭代过程进行深入研究。
AI.result: Agent能解决多个独立流水线阶段，表明阶段级自动化可行；但缺乏预定义迭代标准时表现最差，需要科学判断力；尝试通过中间输出可视化进行自我评估但多数失败；端到端流水线正确串联超出当前能力；识别了计算资源管理和大规模数据泛化等新挑战。
AI.conclusion: 提炼了构建科学任务和开放性问题的严格评价标准的原则。

title: Boundary Variance Inflation Causes Acquisition Bias in Gaussian Processes
summary: Gaussian processes with stationary kernels on bounded domains exhibit inflated posterior variance near the boundary. Despite being a long-recognized artifact in geostatistics and a source of over-exploration in Bayesian optimization, the causes and effects of boundary-induced acquisition bias are underexplored. We trace the root cause to a simple geometric mechanism: the truncation of the kernel correlation neighborhood at the domain boundary creates an observation-independent distortion that worsens with dimensionality. We show how this distortion manifests across three acquisition classes: variance maximization concentrates selections at the corners, whereas negative integrated posterior variance and expected predictive information gain move selections inward to axis-aligned interior shells. These patterns arise without reference to any objective function, meaning that acquisition behavior can be dominated by kernel geometry rather than the desired task-specific uncertainty. To quantify this, we introduce a function-free selection-profile diagnostic for arbitrary acquisitions, kernels, and bounded-domain geometries.

AI.tldr: 高斯过程在有限域上使用平稳核时，由于核相关邻域在边界处被截断，导致后验方差在边界处虚高，进而引发采集函数在贝叶斯优化中产生边界偏好。这种偏差与目标函数无关，且随维度增加而加剧，不同采集函数表现出不同的边界选择模式（角点聚集 vs. 轴向内部壳层）。
AI.motivation: 尽管边界引起的后验方差膨胀是地统计学中已知的伪影，且在贝叶斯优化中会导致过度探索，但其根本原因和影响尚未被充分研究。本文旨在揭示这一现象的几何机制及其对采集函数行为的影响。
AI.method: 从几何机制出发，将边界偏差归因于核相关邻域在域边界处的截断；通过理论分析和仿真，展示三种采集函数（方差最大化、负积分后验方差、期望预测信息增益）在无目标函数下的选择模式；提出一个与函数无关的选择剖面诊断工具。
AI.result: 方差最大化采集将选择集中在角点；负积分后验方差和期望预测信息增益则将选择推向轴向内部壳层。这些模式与目标函数无关，完全由核几何驱动。
AI.conclusion: 采集行为可能被核几何主导而非任务特定的不确定性，必须正视并诊断边界引起的采集偏差。

title: MEC-Cox: Machine-Learning-Assisted Generalized Entropy Calibration for ATT Marginal Hazard-Ratio Estimation
summary: Externally controlled survival trials are increasingly used when concurrent randomized controls are infeasible, particularly in oncology and rare-disease settings with time-to-event endpoints. We target an average-treatment-effect-on-the-treated (ATT)-type marginal hazard-ratio estimand, comparing treatment with counterfactual control in the treated trial population, and estimate it using inverse-probability-weighted (IPW) Cox regression. Valid inference is challenging because IPW Cox regression depends on the weights through both event contributions and risk-set averages, making flexible machine-learning nuisance estimation difficult to incorporate directly. Building on machine-learning-assisted generalized entropy calibration (MEC) by Lee and Kim (2026), we propose MEC-Cox for ATT-weighted IPW Cox regression. The method begins with normalized source-propensity-score odds weights for external controls and then applies Bregman calibration to balance cross-fitted prognostic summaries between external controls and treated trial patients. The calibration basis may include control-survival predictions, Cox linear predictors, penalized-survival-model predictions, or other prognostic-score summaries. MEC-updated weights therefore play a dual role as source-transport and prognostic-score balancing weights. We establish consistency, characterize a calibration-induced efficiency gain, and develop a stacked sandwich variance estimator. Simulations show that MEC-Cox can reduce bias, increase efficiency, and improve coverage through flexible machine-learning-assisted adjustment.

AI.tldr: 针对外部对照生存试验中的ATT边际风险比估计，提出MEC-Cox方法，利用机器学习辅助的广义熵校准进行IPW加权Cox回归，通过平衡预后评分实现偏差减少和效率提升。
AI.motivation: 在外部对照生存试验中，当随机对照不可行时，需要有效的ATT型边际风险比估计方法。现有IPW Cox回归难以直接融入灵活的机器学习 nuisance 估计，因为权重同时影响事件贡献和风险集均值。
AI.method: 基于Lee和Kim(2026)的MEC方法，提出MEC-Cox：先用标准化源倾向得分优势比权重初始化外部对照权重，再通过Bregman校准平衡交叉拟合的预后摘要（如对照生存预测、Cox线性预测、惩罚生存模型预测等），最终权重兼具源传输和预后评分平衡双重作用。
AI.result: 建立了MEC-Cox的一致性，刻画了校准诱导的效率增益，并开发了堆叠三明治方差估计量。模拟表明MEC-Cox通过灵活的机器学习辅助调整能够减少偏差、提高效率并改善覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: MEC-Cox为外部对照生存试验中的ATT边际风险比估计提供了一种有效的机器学习辅助加权Cox回归方法。

title: Data-Driven Robust Model Reference Adaptive Control with Parameter Convergence
summary: This paper provides a data-driven design guaranteeing parameter convergence in model reference adaptive control (MRAC) when the to-be-controlled system is subject to process noise. In the context of MRAC, parameter convergence refers to ensuring convergence of the adaptive gains to a solution of the matching equations, or to an approximate solution when noise is present. In classical MRAC, even small noise may induce parameter drift, thus lacking robustness to noise. Meanwhile, existing robust MRAC methods cannot ensure parameter convergence without imposing excitation conditions on data. A key feature of the proposed framework is to ensure convergence of the adaptive gains to an approximate solution of the matching equations without relying on persistently exciting signals. Furthermore, the matching error can be explicitly characterized as a function of the noise. This explicit characterization allows to establish a necessary and sufficient condition on the noise characteristics under which the limit closed-loop system matrix is Hurwitz. In the noise-free case, the proposed framework results in exact parameter convergence. Notably, as compared to existing methods achieving exact parameter convergence in the noise-free case, the condition on data in the proposed framework is weaker.

AI.tldr: 本文针对存在过程噪声的模型参考自适应控制（MRAC）系统，提出了一种数据驱动的设计方法，确保自适应增益收敛到匹配方程的近似解，无需持续激励信号，并可显式刻画噪声与匹配误差的关系。
AI.motivation: 经典MRAC中即使微小噪声也可能导致参数漂移，缺乏鲁棒性；现有鲁棒MRAC方法无法在不施加激励条件的情况下保证参数收敛。因此，需要一种既能抗噪声又能实现参数收敛的设计框架。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动框架，通过不依赖持续激励信号的方式保证自适应增益收敛到匹配方程的近似解，并建立噪声特性与闭环系统矩阵Hurwitz条件之间的充要关系。
AI.result: 所提框架在有噪声情况下可显式刻画匹配误差与噪声的关系，并给出闭环系统矩阵为Hurwitz的充要条件；无噪声时实现精确参数收敛；且所需数据条件弱于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种更鲁棒且条件更弱的MRAC参数收敛方案，兼具噪声鲁棒性与参数收敛保证，并能显式量化噪声对匹配误差的影响。

title: Why Limit the Residual Stream to Layers and Not Tokens? Persistent Memory for Continuous Latent Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities on mathematical and multi-hop planning tasks. The CoCoNuT (Chain of Continuous Thought) paradigm~\cite{hao2024coconut} extends this by enabling models to reason in latent space, exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously rather than committing to a single chain early on. However, we identify a limitation we term the \textbf{concept bottleneck}. At each reasoning pass, intermediate hidden states are overwritten, causing the model to lose critical facts computed in earlier steps as reasoning depth increases. We observe this empirically. On HotpotQA, vanilla CoCoNuT (10.4\% EM) fails to improve over the CoT baseline (11.0\% EM), and performance degrades with curriculum depth on GSM8K. To address this, we propose \textbf{AGCLR} (Adaptive Gated Continuous Latent Reasoning), which augments CoCoNuT with a \textit{Gated Concept Stream}. A persistent residual memory maintained across all reasoning passes, controlled by three learned gates: a \textit{write} gate that commits intermediate facts to memory, a \textit{read} gate that retrieves relevant prior states, and a \textit{forget} gate that prunes irrelevant context. Evaluated on GSM8K, HotpotQA, and ProsQA using GPT-2 as our base model, AGCLR achieves consistent improvements across all types of datasets. With the performance gap compounding as curriculum depth increases, directly resolving the concept bottleneck. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JJJJ/README.md

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGCLR方法，通过门控概念流（写门、读门、遗忘门）解决CoCoNuT在潜在空间推理中的概念瓶颈问题，即在深层推理时中间隐状态被覆盖导致信息丢失。在GSM8K、HotpotQA、ProsQA上基于GPT-2的评估显示，AGCLR持续优于CoCoNuT和CoT基线。
AI.motivation: CoCoNuT虽然在潜在空间进行连续推理，但存在概念瓶颈：每个推理步的中间隐状态会被覆盖，导致模型在推理深度增加时丢失早期已计算的关键事实，表现为在HotpotQA上CoCoNuT（10.4% EM）甚至低于CoT基线（11.0% EM），且在GSM8K上随课程深度增加性能退化。
AI.method: 提出AGCLR（自适应门控连续潜在推理），在CoCoNuT基础上增加持久残差记忆（门控概念流），通过三个学习门控制：写门（将中间事实提交到记忆）、读门（检索相关先验状态）、遗忘门（修剪无关上下文），从而在推理过程中保留关键信息。
AI.result: 以GPT-2为基础模型，在GSM8K、HotpotQA、ProsQA三个数据集上评估，AGCLR在所有数据集上均取得一致改进，且随课程深度增加性能差距持续扩大，直接解决了概念瓶颈问题。
AI.conclusion: AGCLR通过门控机制维护持久记忆，有效克服了连续潜在推理中的信息遗忘问题，验证了在深层推理中保留中间事实对于提升推理质量的重要性。

title: Emergence via Phase Transitions: Mechanism Landscapes and Universal Convergence Across Complex Systems
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables; 15-page Supplementary Information with complete proofs included
summary: Across machine learning, biology, and physics, independently evolving systems often converge toward strikingly similar high-level structures despite radically different microscopic details. Grokking circuits converge across random seeds, evolutionary lineages rediscover similar metabolic solutions, and renormalization flows approach common fixed points. We propose the Hierarchical Emergence Framework (HEF) as a candidate universality framework for such convergence phenomena. HEF models emergence as a phase transition in a mechanism landscape constrained by thermodynamic and information-theoretic laws. The framework introduces a critical energy threshold Ec separating an exploration regime with competing mechanisms from a convergence regime governed by a unique minimum-cost mechanism. Under structural assumptions, we prove physical feasibility, derive strict metric contraction, and establish convergence toward a unique fixed-point representation independent of initial conditions. We further connect this convergence structure to causal emergence through Effective Information and mechanism competition entropy. To test the framework, we study delayed generalization ("grokking") in modular arithmetic transformers across 111 experiments. We identify a reproducible empirical fingerprint of the Ec transition: the weight norm peaks systematically before grokking in 92% of runs. Normalized accuracy curves collapse onto a tanh kink (R^2=0.93) consistent with a Landau-Ginzburg universality class, and all grokked models converge to 0.9745+/-0.014 regardless of initialization, weight decay, or training fraction (ANOVA p>0.13). HEF is not presented as a universal theory of emergence, but as a falsifiable mathematical scaffold for studying convergence phenomena across complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层级涌现框架（HEF），将涌现建模为受热力学与信息论约束的机制景观中的相变过程。该框架引入临界能量阈值Ec，区分探索机制与收敛机制，并证明在结构假设下收敛到唯一的固定点表示。通过在111个模算术变换器延迟泛化（grokking）实验中的验证，发现权重范数在grokking前系统性地达到峰值（92%运行），归一化准确率塌缩到tanh扭结（R²=0.93），且所有grokked模型收敛到0.9745±0.014的精度，与初始化、权重衰减或训练分数无关（ANOVA p>0.13）。
AI.motivation: 机器学习、生物学和物理学中独立演化的系统尽管微观细节迥异，却常常趋同于惊人的相似高层结构（如grokking电路收敛、进化谱系发现相似代谢方案、重正化流趋向共同不动点）。现有理论缺乏统一框架来解释这种跨系统的收敛现象。
AI.method: 提出层级涌现框架（HEF），将涌现建模为机制景观中的相变过程，引入临界能量阈值Ec分离探索机制与收敛机制；从理论上证明物理可行性、严格度量收缩及唯一固定点收敛性；通过111个模算术变换器的grokking实验进行实证检验，分析权重范数峰值、归一化准确率塌缩行为及最终收敛精度。
AI.result: 权重范数在grokking前系统性地达到峰值（92%运行）；归一化准确率曲线塌缩到tanh扭结（R²=0.93），符合Landau-Ginzburg普适类；所有grokked模型收敛到0.9745±0.014，与初始化、权重衰减或训练分数无关（ANOVA p>0.13）。
AI.conclusion: HEF不作为涌现的普适理论提出，而是作为一个可证伪的数学框架，用于研究跨复杂系统的收敛现象。

title: Improving Bayesian Optimization via Training-Aware Conditional Diffusion Models
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used approach for black-box optimization that uses a Gaussian process (GP) as a surrogate and guides sequential evaluations via an acquisition function, with the ultimate goal of locating the global optimum $\mathbf{x}^{\star}$. To align with this goal, information-based acquisition functions such as Predictive Entropy Search (PES) model $\mathbf{x}^{\star}$ as a random variable and reduce the entropy of its distribution, but approximating this distribution via traditional GP posterior sampling is computationally expensive. To address this limitation, we leverage Conditional Diffusion Models (CDMs) to efficiently approximate the distribution of $\mathbf{x}^{\star}$ and develop BO-inherent training strategies for CDMs. Motivated by the structural properties of the CDM-learned distribution, we further develop an acquisition strategy termed Diffusion-based Mode Seeking (DMS) to guide the sequential evaluation. We establish a sub-optimality guarantee for the CDM-learned distribution and demonstrate through extensive experiments that DMS outperforms standard BO baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用条件扩散模型高效近似最优解分布，并开发基于扩散的模态搜索采集策略，在贝叶斯优化中取得优于基准方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于信息的采集函数（如PES）将最优解建模为随机变量并通过熵减来指导优化，但传统高斯过程后验采样的计算成本过高，难以高效近似最优解分布。
AI.method: 利用条件扩散模型高效近似最优解分布，设计BO固有的训练策略；基于扩散模型学习到的分布结构特性，提出扩散模态搜索采集策略。
AI.result: 建立了条件扩散模型学习到的分布的次优性保证；大量实验表明扩散模态搜索优于标准贝叶斯优化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型能够高效且有效地近似贝叶斯优化中的最优解分布，结合所提采集策略可显著提升优化性能。

title: Combining Reinforcement Learning with Arc-search Interior-Point Method for Path Planning
summary: Path planning in environments containing obstacles has numerous practical applications. The problem is challenging because it is inherently nonlinear and nonconvex. Consequently, a variety of techniques have been developed to address this problem, among which machine learning and optimal control (or optimization) have emerged as two prominent approaches. In general, machine learning methods do not require a high-fidelity model, and a trained agent can often generate a feasible path in real time. However, the resulting path is not necessarily optimal with respect to performance objectives such as minimizing path length or travel time. In contrast, optimal control and optimization methods typically rely on high-fidelity models and often require computational effort that may not satisfy real-time constraints. Nevertheless, these methods are more likely to produce optimal or near-optimal solutions. To overcome the limitations of each approach while exploiting their respective strengths, this paper proposes a framework that combines reinforcement learning with an arc-search interior-point method for path planning. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively integrates the real-time decision-making capability of reinforcement learning with the optimization performance of the arc-search interior-point method, resulting in improved path-planning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将强化学习与弧搜索内点法相结合的路径规划框架，以融合机器学习实时决策能力与最优控制优化性能的优势，克服各自局限性。
AI.motivation: 路径规划问题具有非线性和非凸性，传统方法中机器学习可实时生成可行路径但非最优，最优控制/优化方法能产生最优解但计算量大、难以满足实时性要求。为克服各自局限并发挥优势，需结合两种方法。
AI.method: 提出一种将强化学习与弧搜索内点法相结合的混合框架，利用强化学习实现实时决策，同时采用弧搜索内点法进行优化求解。
AI.result: 数值仿真表明，该方法有效整合了强化学习的实时决策能力与弧搜索内点法的优化性能，提升了路径规划的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合框架能够克服单一方法的局限性，在保证实时性的同时获得更优的路径规划结果。

title: Automatic Extraction of Structured Information from Brain MRI Reports Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model
summary: Objectives: Automatic data extraction from free-text radiology reports enables large-scale research, but few studies assessed the performance of large language models (LLMs) on Dutch neuroradiology reports. Methods: We analyzed 947 brain MRI reports from a tertiary memory clinic (2016-2021), authored by consultant neuroradiologists. Trained medical students annotated thirty variables; 100 reports were double-annotated to assess inter-rater reliability. We evaluated the performance of the open-weight LLM LLaMA 3.1 using different languages (Dutch vs. English translation) and few-shot prompting with different example selection strategies. Performance was evaluated using balanced accuracy for categorical variables, accuracy and mean absolute error for counts, and text similarity for free-text. Metrics were computed across 10 random splits of the 947 reports. Results: LLaMA 3.1 demonstrated high zero-shot performance for visual rating scores (mean [95%-CI]): Medial Temporal Atrophy: 90% [77-100%] on the left and 96% [94-99%] on the right, Global Cortical Atrophy: 87% [83-91%], and Fazekas: 94% [93-96%]. Microbleed mentions were detected with 93% accuracy [92-95%] and infarct mentions with 82% [80-84%]. Text similarity for lesion location reached 0.95 [0.95-0.96]. Performance was lower for numerical variables: 80% [78-82%] for the number of microbleeds and 66% [63-68%] for infarcts. English translation yielded comparable results. Few-shot prompting improved performance for numerical variables, achieving 92% [90-93%] for microbleeds and 81% [77-85%] for infarcts using structural similarity-based selection. Conclusion: LLaMA 3.1 shows strong potential for extracting data from Dutch neuroradiology reports. Few-shot prompting enhances performance for numerical variables, whereas challenges remain for location-specific variables.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了LLaMA 3.1从荷兰语神经放射学报告中自动提取数据的能力，在视觉评分任务上表现优异，少样本提示可提升数值变量提取性能。
AI.motivation: 从自由文本放射学报告中自动提取数据可支持大规模研究，但大型语言模型在荷兰语神经放射学报告上的表现尚缺乏评估。
AI.method: 分析了947份脑部MRI报告，由医学学生对30个变量进行标注（100份双标注评估信度）。评估LLaMA 3.1在不同语言（荷兰语vs英语翻译）和少样本提示策略下的表现，使用平衡准确率、准确率、平均绝对误差和文本相似度等指标。
AI.result: LLaMA 3.1在视觉评分任务上零样本表现优异（内侧颞叶萎缩90-96%、全脑皮质萎缩87%、Fazekas 94%），微出血检测准确率93%，梗死检测82%。数值变量表现较低（微出血数80%、梗死数66%）。英语翻译结果可比。基于结构相似性选择的少样本提示将数值变量提升至92%（微出血）和81%（梗死）。
AI.conclusion: LLaMA 3.1在荷兰语神经放射学报告数据提取方面潜力巨大，少样本提示可增强数值变量性能，但位置特定变量仍具挑战。

title: STARIXNet: Multivariate and Multi-attribute Deep Learning Approach to Real-Time Resource Allocation in Cloud Platforms
summary: Intelligent scaling of microservices in cloud platforms is crucial for mitigating escalating compute costs while avoiding service disruptions. Current solutions are limited to the univariate space, typically focusing on CPU usage alone to drive scaling decisions. Moreover, they address the problem as a purely forecasting task, focusing on prediction precision while neglecting the greater risks of underestimation and delays in system responsiveness. Alternative solutions are computationally complex, making them impractical for large-scale, real-time deployments. To address these challenges, we present STARIXNet, a lightweight neural network that guides resource allocation decisions in the multivariate space by capturing spatio-temporal relationships among multiple system metrics. STARIXNet models multiple quasi-dependent attributes, in particular the (S)easonal, (T)emporal, (A)uto-(R)egressive (I)ntegrated, and e(X)ogenous patterns, then implements an aggregation policy to finalize scaling decisions, prioritizing service stability, followed by cost-efficiency, over raw forecast accuracy. We empirically demonstrate the performance of STARIXNet by benchmarking against existing solutions in real-world settings. STARIXNet is deployed for critical production microservices at Walmart achieving tangible savings ranging from 10\% to 50\%, in addition to intangible benefits through improved service stability and customer experience.

AI.tldr: STARIXNet是一个轻量级神经网络，通过捕获多维系统指标中的时空关系来指导微服务扩缩容决策，优先保障服务稳定性，在Walmart生产环境中实现了10%-50%的成本节省。
AI.motivation: 现有微服务扩缩容方案局限于单变量空间（通常仅关注CPU使用率），且将问题视为纯预测任务而忽视低估风险和系统响应延迟，替代方案计算复杂难以大规模实时部署。
AI.method: STARIXNet是一个轻量级神经网络，建模多维准依赖属性（季节性、时间性、自回归整合、外生模式），捕获系统指标间的时空关系，并通过聚合策略确定扩缩容决策，优先保障服务稳定性再考虑成本效率。
AI.result: 在Walmart关键生产微服务中部署，实现了10%到50%的可量化成本节省，以及通过改善服务稳定性和客户体验带来的无形收益。
AI.conclusion: STARIXNet在多维空间中进行资源分配决策，比现有方案更有效平衡服务稳定性与成本效率，适用于大规模实时生产环境。

title: LOTTERY: Learning from Reference-Only Samples in Two-Sample Testing under Size Asymmetry
summary: Data-adaptive two-sample testing assesses if two samples come from the same distribution, using a discrepancy learned from the data (e.g., via kernel-based feature representations). Such methods typically rely on data splitting to decouple learning from testing and control type I error. However, this paradigm is ill-suited to few-shot settings with severe sample-size imbalance: abundant reference samples are available, while only a handful of query samples arrive. In this paper, we show how this imbalance can be leveraged constructively. Using abundant reference data, we learn reference-dependent representations that summarize salient structure of the reference distribution and provide informative signals for detecting departures. We incorporate a collection of representation families that capture both global and local structure, and adaptively weight them using only reference samples via an uncertainty-guided principle. Theoretically, we establish permutation-based type I error control and show consistency of the aggregated test: as the sample sizes grow, the test power converges to one whenever the representation set contains at least one consistent representation. Empirically, our aggregation achieves strong performance across a range of benchmarks while retaining type I error control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适应数据不平衡的核双样本检验方法，利用大量参考样本学习表示并自适应加权，在仅有少量查询样本时仍能控制类型I错误并保证检验一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有数据自适应双样本检验依赖数据分割来解耦学习和测试，但在参考样本丰富、查询样本极少的少样本不平衡场景下表现不佳，需要一种能利用这种不平衡特性的检验方法。
AI.method: 利用大量参考数据学习参考依赖的表示（涵盖全局与局部结构），通过不确定性引导原则仅用参考样本自适应加权多个表示族，并基于排列检验控制类型I错误。
AI.result: 理论上证明了排列检验的类型I错误控制以及聚合检验的一致性（当表示集中至少有一个一致表示时，检验势随样本量趋近于1）；实验上在多个基准上取得强性能且保持类型I错误控制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有效解决了少样本不平衡场景下的双样本检验问题，通过参考数据驱动的表示学习与自适应加权实现了统计效能与错误控制的兼顾。

title: A null controllability data assimilation for the bulk-surface heat equation with dynamic boundary conditions
summary: We address the inverse problem of reconstructing the state at a final time $T_0$ of a parabolic equation with dynamic boundary conditions of Wentzell type, from a distributed interior observation on a subdomain $ω\subset Ω$. Our approach combines (i) a Carleman-type observability inequality for the bulk-surface system, with (ii) a Tikhonov-regularized optimal-control reformulation of the data assimilation problem, and (iii) a fully implementable spatio-temporal discretization based on a Lie splitting that decouples the bulk and surface dynamics. We prove an exact reconstruction theorem for the continuous problem, derive a stability inequality, and analyze a penalized discrete scheme. We then propose an adaptive post-processing step that optimally combines the regularized reconstruction with the observation itself; under noisy data, the resulting estimator automatically selects between full post-processing and the raw reconstruction without prior knowledge of the noise level. Extensive numerical experiments on a two-dimensional Wentzell heat equation validate the method. A semilinear extension to the Allen-Cahn nonlinearity is treated via a Picard outer loop with Schauder fixed-point convergence; two complementary experiments reveal an intrinsic observability-nonlinearity trade-off in the bulk-surface setting.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带Wentzell型动态边界条件的抛物方程，提出了从子域内部观测数据反演终时刻状态的方法。通过Carleman型可观性不等式、Tikhonov正则化最优控制重构、Lie分裂时空离散，实现了连续问题的精确重构定理、稳定性分析和离散格式。自适应后处理步骤能在未知噪声水平下自动选择最优估计。二维Wentzell热方程数值实验验证了方法，并扩展到Allen-Cahn非线性情形，揭示了体表系统中的可观性-非线性权衡。
AI.motivation: 解决带Wentzell型动态边界条件的抛物方程中，从子域内部观测数据反演终时刻状态的逆问题，这是数据同化领域的核心挑战。
AI.method: (i) Carleman型可观性不等式建立体表系统的可观性；(ii) Tikhonov正则化将数据同化转化为最优控制问题；(iii) Lie分裂解耦体相与表面动力学实现时空离散化；(iv) 自适应后处理步骤在噪声未知下自动选择最优估计；(v) 对Allen-Cahn非线性采用Picard外循环与Schauder不动点收敛分析。
AI.result: 证明了连续问题的精确重构定理与稳定性不等式；分析了惩罚离散格式；数值实验在二维Wentzell热方程上验证了有效性；在Allen-Cahn非线性扩展中揭示了可观性-非线性间的内在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法能有效从局部观测重构Wentzell边界条件抛物系统的终时刻状态，自适应后处理无需噪声先验信息，且可扩展至半线性情形，但非线性强度与可观性之间存在固有折衷。

title: Some hypotheses on how chatbots work in problem-solving-driven conversations. Large Language Models as confirmation of the Innovation Illusion
summary:
This article offers a perspective on the nature of chatbots as genuine conversation partners when discussing problems in relation to their solutions. What can chatbots do and what can't they do, and how can this be explained? Our argument draws on Aggregation Dynamics, Cognitive Linguistics, Neuropsychology and Psychology.
  Our argument focuses on basic chatbots in the hope of thereby making statements about the core functionality of more advanced chatbots. Basic chatbots are assumed to consist of a Large Language Model (LLM) with a simple interface.
  The main results are: a description of human understanding and thinking based on so-called metaphorical problem propagations; the hypothesis that text dataset used for training LLMs have specific characteristics and that these text datasets only partially imitate human thinking and understanding; the hypothesis that the LLM training process encodes artificial metaphorical problem propagations into an LLM from these datasets; our conclusion that a basic chatbot cannot be a thinking partner capable of matching humans; our conclusion that further development of the Large Language Model will not lead to this either.
  Yann LeCun states: "Animals and humans exhibit learning abilities and understandings of the world that are far beyond the capabilities of current AI and machine learning (ML) systems." Our conclusions are in line with this. LeCun's vision and ours are at odds with the optimism of Big Tech. That does not alter the fact that chatbots exist, that they are being used on a massive scale, by both individuals and organisations, and that it is therefore socially and politically important to understand them. Our article aims to contribute to the discussion on the functioning, benefits and drawbacks of chatbots.
  We have not yet encountered the approach we used to arrive at our conclusions in our research into how chatbots work.

AI.tldr: 本文从聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学视角，论证了基础聊天机器人（基于LLM）无法成为真正的人类思维伙伴，因为训练数据仅部分模仿人类思维，LLM训练过程编码的是人工隐喻问题传播，而非真实理解。结论与LeCun观点一致，与科技巨头乐观论调相左。
AI.motivation: 澄清聊天机器人作为对话伙伴的本质能力边界，回应科技巨头对AI能力的过度乐观，提供社会和政治层面理解聊天机器人的理论基础。
AI.method: 跨学科理论分析，整合聚合动力学、认知语言学、神经心理学和心理学视角，聚焦基础聊天机器人（LLM+简单界面）的核心功能分析。
AI.result: 提出了人类思维基于"隐喻问题传播"的描述；指出LLM训练文本数据集仅部分模仿人类思维；LLM训练过程编码了人工隐喻问题传播；基础聊天机器人无法成为与人类匹敌的思维伙伴；进一步开发LLM也无法实现这一点。
AI.conclusion: 聊天机器人本质上无法实现人类水平的思维与理解，未来LLM发展也不会改变这一根本局限。

title: TriHead-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network with Triple-Head Discriminator for Carbon Emission Time Series Generation
summary: Accurate carbon emission monitoring is critical for climate policy and emerging regulatory mechanisms such as the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, yet city-level high-frequency monitoring data remain extremely scarce, severely limiting data-hungry deep learning models. Time series generation is a natural remedy, but existing GAN and diffusion-based generators often provide limited explicit supervision for the domain structure of carbon emission data: they may match marginal distributional statistics while insufficiently preserving cross-variable correlations between CO$_2$ and co-emitted pollutants and meteorological factors, and tend to collapse the first-difference statistics of atmospheric measurements, producing sequences that are smooth on average but lack the realistic step-wise variability of the underlying signals. We propose TriHead-GAN, a Transformer-based adversarial framework whose triple-head discriminator jointly supervises three complementary aspects of the joint distribution: distributional authenticity via a Wasserstein critic, cross-variable dependency via leakage-free regression of the target variable, and step-wise temporal smoothness via adjacent-difference prediction. The generator combines global self-attention with local temporal convolution, per-step noise injection, and an anti-smoothing loss that matches first-difference statistics. Experiments on the self-collected Changsha Carbon dataset, two public carbon datasets (China, US), and the ETTh1 benchmark show that TriHead-GAN achieves favorable performance over mainstream baselines on the vast majority of settings, and that the resulting synthetic windows improve downstream forecasting accuracy in low-resource carbon monitoring scenarios.

AI.tldr: TriHead-GAN是一种基于Transformer的对抗框架，通过三头判别器联合监督分布真实性、跨变量依赖性和逐步时间平滑性，有效生成高质量的城市级碳排放时间序列数据，显著提升下游预测精度。
AI.motivation: 城市级碳排放高频监测数据极度稀缺，严重限制了深度学习模型的性能。现有GAN和扩散模型在生成碳排放数据时，未能充分保留CO₂与共排放污染物及气象因子之间的跨变量相关性，且时间序列的步态变异性不足。
AI.method: 提出TriHead-GAN，包含：(1) 三头判别器：Wasserstein评论家监督分布真实性、无泄漏回归监督跨变量依赖性、相邻差分预测监督逐步时间平滑性；(2) 生成器：全局自注意力+局部时序卷积、每步噪声注入、抗平滑损失匹配一阶差分统计量。
AI.result: 在自采长沙碳排放数据集、两个公开碳排放数据集（中国、美国）以及ETTh1基准上，TriHead-GAN在绝大多数设置下优于主流基线方法，生成的合成窗口显著提升了低资源碳监测场景下的下游预测准确度。
AI.conclusion: TriHead-GAN通过多维度联合监督有效解决了碳排放时间序列生成中跨变量相关性和时序变异性的保持问题，为碳监测数据稀缺场景提供了可行的数据增广方案。

title: Improving the sharpness in neural network-based parametric post-processing of ensemble forecasts
summary: Statistical post-processing has proven to be an effective tool in improving ensemble forecast of different weather variables. Case studies show that post-processing can remedy the typically underdispersive and potentially biased behaviour of the ensemble while optimizing a proper scoring rule expressing the forecast skill. The price of these positive effects is generally a deterioration in sharpness; the width of the central prediction intervals and the uncertainty of the predictions are increasing, especially for shorter lead times. This work aims to reduce the extent of the latter phenomenon for neural network-based parametric post-processing methods by extending the network's loss function with a penalty term. We demonstrate the effect of the proposed technique for 2m temperature ensemble forecasts of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts downloaded from the EUPPBench benchmark dataset and verified against synoptic observations. Here, the predictive distribution is Gaussian, and we use the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) as loss function. The case studies confirm a substantial relative decrease ($8.2\%-12.5\%$) in the width of the nominal central prediction interval compared to the width of the predictive distribution computed without the penalty term, while there is no deterioration in the mean CRPS of probabilistic forecasts and in the RMSE of the predictive mean.

AI.tldr: 本文针对神经网络参数化后处理方法中预测区间过宽的问题，提出在损失函数中加入惩罚项，在保持CRPS和RMSE性能不变的前提下，使中心预测区间宽度相对减小8.2%-12.5%。
AI.motivation: 统计后处理虽能改善集合预报的欠离散和有偏性，但会降低锐度（预测区间变宽、不确定性增大），尤其在短预报时效。本文旨在减少神经网络参数化后处理方法中这一现象。
AI.method: 在神经网络的损失函数（CRPS）中引入惩罚项，对预测分布的宽度进行约束。使用ECMWF的2米温度集合预报数据（来自EUPPBench数据集），假设预测分布为高斯分布。
AI.result: 加入惩罚项后，名义中心预测区间宽度相对减小8.2%-12.5%，同时概率预报的CRPS和预报均值的RMSE没有恶化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的惩罚项方法能有效提升预测锐度，且不牺牲预报技能，是一种改善神经网络后处理预报质量的可行方案。

title: An Iterative Computational Framework for Infinite-Horizon Mean-Field Linear-Quadratic Zero-Sum Stochastic Differential Games
summary: This work develops an iterative computational framework to obtain saddle-point solutions for infinite-horizon two-person mean-field linear-quadratic zero-sum stochastic differential games. By generalizing classical iterative framework, we construct a monotonically increasing matrix sequence to decouple the strongly coupled, analytically intractable original problem into a set of tractable subproblems. By sequentially computing the stabilizing solutions of the coupled algebraic Riccati equations for these subproblems, we can further derive the solution to the original problem. Rigorous convergence analysis is established to validate the proposed iterative algorithm. Different from existing algorithms limited to specific simplified setups, this framework proposes the first universal computational paradigm applicable to a broad class of game-driven Riccati equations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种迭代计算框架，用于求解无限时域两人平均场线性二次型零和随机微分博弈的鞍点解，通过构造单调递增矩阵序列将强耦合的原始问题解耦为一系列可处理的子问题，并证明了算法的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有算法局限于特定的简化设置，缺乏适用于广义博弈驱动Riccati方程的统一计算范式，因此需要开发一种通用的计算框架来处理强耦合、解析上难以处理的无限时域两人平均场线性二次型零和随机微分博弈问题。
AI.method: 通过推广经典迭代框架，构造单调递增矩阵序列将原始强耦合问题解耦为一系列可处理的子问题；顺序计算这些子问题的耦合代数Riccati方程的镇定解，进而推导原始问题的解。
AI.result: 建立了严格的收敛性分析来验证所提出的迭代算法，并提出了第一个适用于广义博弈驱动Riccati方程的统一计算范式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架突破了现有算法仅适用于特定简化设置的局限性，为一大类博弈驱动的Riccati方程提供了首个通用计算范式。

title: Land cover and flood type govern the detection limits of satellite-based flood mapping across diverse global flood events
summary: Floods are among the most destructive natural hazards, and their increasing frequency under climate change makes satellite-based inundation mapping essential for disaster response. Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite archives offer geographic transferability, but their operational reliability across diverse, unseen events remains uncharacterized. Here we deploy Prithvi-EO-2.0 across 19 out-of-distribution flood events (2017-2025) spanning six continents, eight climate zones, and six flood mechanisms, validating against two independent reference products. Detection accuracy depended jointly on land cover and flood type, with cropland yielding the highest agreement (IoU=52%) and riverine events the strongest detection (F1=0.69), while tree cover and built-up areas showed near-zero detection (IoU=4%) regardless of flood mechanism. Dual-reference validation revealed that apparent model error partly reflects definitional inconsistency between reference products rather than detection failure. Iterative pipeline testing identified 23 failure modes, with pipeline engineering dominating initial error over model capacity. These findings establish environment-dependent detection boundaries for operational satellite flood mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了地理空间基础模型Prithvi-EO-2.0在19个全球分布、未见过的洪水事件（2017-2025）中的泛化性能，发现检测准确率取决于土地覆盖和洪水类型（农田IoU=52%，河流F1=0.69；树冠和建成区IoU=4%），并揭示了参考产品间定义不一致和流水线工程错误主导了表观模型误差。
AI.motivation: 洪水灾害日益频繁，星载洪涝制图对灾害响应至关重要。地理空间基础模型在未见过的、多样化的洪水事件中的操作可靠性尚未被系统刻画，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 使用Prithvi-EO-2.0模型，在跨越六大洲、八个气候带、六种洪水机制的19个分布外洪水事件上进行测试，并使用两个独立参考产品进行验证；通过迭代流水线测试识别故障模式。
AI.result: 检测准确性取决于土地覆盖和洪水类型：农田IoU=52%，河流事件F1=0.69；树冠和建成区IoU=4%。双参考验证表明表观误差部分源于参考产品间定义不一致；23种故障模式中流水线工程主导初始误差。
AI.conclusion: 建立了面向操作化星载洪涝制图的环境依赖型检测边界，明确了模型能力与流水线工程之间的误差分配。

title: Enabling KV Caching of Shared Prefix for Diffusion Language Models
summary:
Key-value (KV) caching for shared prefixes is essential for high-throughput large language model (LLM) serving, but it faces critical challenges in emerging diffusion language models (DLMs). In DLMs, bidirectional attention means that updating any token dynamically alters the entire context and its corresponding KVs. Thus, existing caching techniques developed for LLMs, which assume that KVs remain invariant once computed, corrupt the shared prefix KVs. Our experiments show that applying these techniques to DLMs causes model accuracy to collapse to near zero.
  To unlock high-throughput DLM serving, we propose bidirectional prefix caching, bicache, the first KV caching technique for shared prefixes in DLMs. bicache is designed based on key observations from our comprehensive analysis: shared prefix KVs remain stable and reusable in shallow layers, while the depth of shallow layers depends on the fraction of shared prefix tokens in each request. Thus, bicache dynamically identifies a safe layer depth for reusing shared prefix KVs and eliminates redundant computation. Evaluations demonstrate that bicache significantly improves serving throughput by 36.3%-98.3% compared to existing techniques without accuracy collapse (only 0-1.8% difference).

AI.tldr: 本文提出bicache，首个面向扩散语言模型(DLM)的共享前缀KV缓存技术。针对DLM双向注意力导致传统LLM缓存技术失效（精度崩溃至近零）的问题，bicache通过关键观察——共享前缀KV在浅层保持稳定可复用，且浅层深度取决于请求中共享前缀token比例——动态识别安全层深度以复用KV，消除冗余计算。实验表明，bicache在精度仅下降0-1.8%前提下，吞吐量提升36.3%-98.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的KV缓存技术假设KV一旦计算即保持不变，但DLM的双向注意力机制使得任何token更新都会动态改变整个上下文及其对应KV，直接套用会导致模型精度崩溃至近零，亟需面向DLM特性的共享前缀KV缓存技术以解锁高吞吐服务。
AI.method: 基于两个关键观察设计：(1)共享前缀KV在浅层网络中保持稳定且可复用；(2)浅层深度与每个请求中共享前缀token占比相关。据此，bicache动态识别可安全复用共享前缀KV的层深度，避免冗余计算。
AI.result: 与现有技术相比，bicache在精度仅下降0-1.8%（无精度崩溃）的前提下，将服务吞吐量提升了36.3%-98.3%。
AI.conclusion: bicache是首个有效解决DLM共享前缀KV缓存问题的方案，通过动态识别安全复用深度，在不造成精度崩溃的情况下显著提升吞吐量，为DLM的高效服务部署提供了关键技术支撑。

title: Rank Intervals for Leaderboards: A Hierarchical Framework for Model Evaluation
summary: Pretrained models are often evaluated on multi-task leaderboards to measure their applicability in diverse contexts. However, current methods for aggregating performance across tasks into leaderboard-level rankings do not address the uncertainty and variability at the task level. While recent works have proposed interval-based model rankings, the principled aggregation of uncertainty from individual tasks to leaderboard-level rankings remains unaddressed, and variation in models' performance across tasks is frequently obscured. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical framework that constructs model rank intervals with statistical guarantees at both levels: task-level rank confidence intervals from pairwise comparisons, and leaderboard-level rank prediction intervals using a conformal approach. This enables reliable quantification of model rank for each observed task and for new potential tasks. Experiments on simulated data and the TabArena and PromptEval (MMLU) benchmarks show that our method yields statistically valid and informative intervals, enabling reliable, uncertainty-aware model ranking on leaderboards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层框架，通过统计方法在任务级和排行榜级构建模型排名区间，实现不确定性感知的模型排名聚合，并在模拟数据和真实基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务排行榜的排名聚合方法未解决任务层面的不确定性和变异性，无法在排行榜级别给出有统计保证的排名区间。
AI.method: 提出分层框架：任务级通过成对比较构建排名置信区间，排行榜级采用保形预测方法构建排名预测区间，实现从任务到排行榜的不确定性聚合。
AI.result: 在模拟数据、TabArena和PromptEval (MMLU)基准上的实验表明，该方法能生成统计有效且信息丰富的排名区间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够实现可靠、不确定性感知的模型排行榜排名，为模型评估提供统计保证。

title: Latent Structural Categorical Matrix Completion with Application to Quasispecies Analysis
summary: Matrix completion has been extensively studied for real-valued data, but existing methods are often limited in handling categorical variables. We propose LCMC, a double-loop optimization framework for categorical matrix completion via latent factorization based on a binary tensor representation. In this setting, each categorical entry is encoded as a one-hot vector along a third tensor mode, thereby preserving its discrete, non-ordinal nature. The outer loop adaptively estimates the latent dimension by iteratively updating it with feedback from the inner loop, while the inner loop reconstructs the categorical matrix through tensor factorization, supported by a corresponding theoretical analysis. To further improve scalability and robustness, we introduce enhancements including a split-merge-refine strategy and an adaptive data reduction technique. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets in viral quasispecies reconstruction, demonstrate that LCMC achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LCMC，一个基于二元张量表示的双循环优化框架，用于分类矩阵补全，通过外循环自适应估计潜在维度、内循环进行张量分解，在病毒准种重建任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有矩阵补全方法主要针对实值数据设计，难以有效处理分类变量的离散、非有序特性。
AI.method: 采用二元张量表示，将分类条目编码为one-hot向量作为第三模态；外循环自适应估计潜在维度，内循环通过张量分解重建分类矩阵；引入分裂-合并-细化策略和自适应数据缩减技术提升可扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实病毒准种重建数据集上，LCMC在准确性和效率方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LCMC有效解决了分类矩阵补全问题，双循环框架与张量分解的结合为处理离散分类数据提供了可行方案。

title: Reconstructing and forecasting disease trajectories of patients with Alzheimer's disease using routine data in resource-constrained settings
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder, and its progression varies substantially across patients. Existing work aims to forecast patients' future cognitive state, with minimal focus on reconstructing the state from past visits. Furthermore, in current research, quantifying predictive uncertainty remains underexplored and relies on costly modalities such as MRI, PET, and CSF, limiting their deployment in resource-limited settings. In this research, our primary objectives are: First, bidirectional prediction of cognitive scores from irregular visits to present the complete disease trajectory. Second, to enable interpolation and extrapolation capabilities to assist clinicians in informed prognostic decision making, and third, to provide a well-calibrated uncertainty estimate for all predictions, and finally, to achieve the objectives using the modalities available during routine visits. We propose a unified framework, GNOVA: A GRU-Neural ODE Variational Autoencoder. The architecture combines a Gated Recurrent Unit encoder and a Neural ODE decoder within a variational autoencoder framework. In our work, we forecast the CDR-SB and MMSE Scores. The GRU encoder allows for any number of inputs at any time point. The Neural-ODE decoder performs continuous estimation, allowing interpolation and extrapolation at any desired time point. The Variational autoencoder allows for uncertainty estimation in predictions. We worked with 1,727 patients from the ADNI dataset over 10 years; the model achieved mean absolute errors of 1.35 and 2.28 for CDR-SB and MMSE scores, respectively, without requiring any neuroimaging or biomarker data. Feature-ablation studies revealed that age, BMI, and APOE4 status were strong predictors. The proposed framework enables the reconstruction of incomplete patient histories and the anticipation of future cognitive states.

AI.tldr: 提出GNOVA框架（GRU-神经ODE变分自编码器），利用常规临床访问数据（无需MRI/PET/CSF）实现认知评分的双向预测、插值与外推，并给出校准的不确定性估计，在ADNI数据集上取得良好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要聚焦预测未来认知状态，较少关注从既往访问重建完整轨迹；且量化预测不确定性的研究不足，同时依赖昂贵的MRI、PET、CSF等模态，限制了在资源有限场景的部署。
AI.method: 提出GNOVA框架，结合GRU编码器（处理任意数量、任意时间点的输入）和神经ODE解码器（实现连续时间估计，支持插值与外推），嵌入变分自编码器架构以提供不确定性估计。仅使用常规临床访问数据。
AI.result: 基于ADNI数据集1,727名患者、10年数据，CDR-SB和MMSE的MAE分别为1.35和2.28；消融实验表明年龄、BMI和APOE4状态为强预测因子。
AI.conclusion: GNOVA框架无需神经影像或生物标志物数据即可重建不完整的患者病史并预测未来认知状态，为临床决策提供支持。

title: When Should an AI Scientist Stop? Verifiable Experiment Steering and Refusal for Autonomous Discovery
comment: Accepted at AI for Science Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: We present CARTOGRAPH, a verification layer for AI scientists that couples unresolved-subspace experiment steering (select), explicit ambiguity closure (resolve), and residual-based library inadequacy detection (refuse). Under a local linear-Gaussian bridge, raw unresolved projection is the isotropic unresolved Fisher-information trace, while CARTOGRAPH-A is the exact unresolved A-optimal rule; closed-form EIG and Box-Hill arise as local comparators rather than global equivalents. Across five testbeds, CARTOGRAPH-A beats raw projection 129W/0T/15L at d = 8 (p < 10^-21) in a replicated structured cascade. More distinctively, the framework tentatively identifies three out-of-library pharmacokinetic mechanisms and then revokes those identifications as residuals expose structural misfit, while one perturbed in-library control stays identified throughout. In low-dimensional pharmacokinetic and filtered EPA settings, near-ties against disagreement are predicted by theory and observed. Finally, in a retrospective audit of 40 positive claims from the published A-Lab autonomous materials system, the refuse guard flags all 4 claims later marked inconclusive under manual reanalysis while passing 32/36 confirmed claims. Code is available at https://github.com/ai4science-boed/cartograph.git

AI.tldr: CARTOGRAPH是一个为AI科学家设计的验证层，通过未解析子空间实验引导（select）、显式模糊闭合（resolve）和基于残差的库不充分性检测（refuse）三个机制，实现对实验设计、假设验证和模型适用性判断的闭环控制。在多个测试平台上，该方法在实验设计性能上显著优于原始投影方法（129胜/0平/15负），并能识别并撤回库外机制，同时在回顾性审计中成功标记所有后续被判定为不确定的阳性声明。
AI.motivation: 现有AI驱动的科学实验系统缺乏对模型不确定性、模糊闭合和库外检测的系统性验证机制，导致实验结果可能不可靠，尤其是在模型假设不满足或数据不充分时无法给出可信度评估。
AI.method: 提出CARTOGRAPH框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) select：基于未解析子空间的实验引导，利用未解析Fisher信息迹作为原始投影；(2) resolve：显式模糊闭合，CARTOGRAPH-A实现精确的未解析A-最优规则；(3) refuse：基于残差的库不充分性检测。在局部线性-高斯桥接下推导出EIG和Box-Hill作为局部比较器而非全局等价物。
AI.result: 在5个测试平台上，CARTOGRAPH-A在d=8维度下以129胜/0平/15负显著优于原始投影（p<10^-21）。能识别出3个库外药代动力学机制并随后撤回，而受扰动的库内对照组始终被保留。在低维药代动力学和过滤EPA设置中观察到理论与实验的一致性。在40个阳性声明的回顾性审计中，拒绝守卫标记了所有4个后续被判定为不确定的声明，同时通过了32/36个已确认声明。
AI.conclusion: CARTOGRAPH为AI科学家提供了一种有效的验证层，能够同时实现高效实验设计、模糊闭合和库外检测，在多个领域展现出显著优势，特别在材料科学等需要高可信度的应用中具有重要价值。

title: Generalization in Nonlinear Least Squares via Learned Feature Geometry
summary: We study the generalization of ridge-regularized nonlinear least-squares models via on-average algorithmic stability, deriving error bounds for local minimizers in terms of a data-dependent effective dimension that reflects the geometry of the gradient model at the trained parameters, through the empirical Jacobian Gram matrix and a residual--curvature term. In the linear case, where the curvature term vanishes, this recovers the classical effective dimension of the Jacobian kernel covariance, but evaluated at the trained model rather than at initialization as is typical in neural tangent kernel analyses. We further bound this effective dimension via covering complexity of the gradient features, leading to guarantees that depend on learned geometry rather than parameter count.
