In particular, for manifold-supported data and piecewise Lipschitz Jacobians, the bounds scale with intrinsic dimension, while for one-hidden-layer ReLU networks, the mechanism can be made explicit through counts of activation-stable regions. Experiments on synthetic manifolds, clustered distributions, and benchmark datasets illustrate trained-Jacobian compression, the tightness of the residual-curvature linearization, and agreement between the stability bound and observed generalization gaps. A key feature of our bounds is the simplicity of their derivation, which follows from first principles using the Brascamp--Lieb inequality under strongly log-concave noise.

AI.tldr: 本文通过平均算法稳定性研究了岭正则化非线性最小二乘模型的泛化性能，推导了局部极小点的误差界，该误差界依赖于数据相关的有效维度，该维度通过经验Jacobian Gram矩阵和残差-曲率项反映训练参数处梯度模型的几何结构。在线性情况下，曲率项消失，恢复为Jacobian核协方差的经典有效维度，但评估的是训练模型而非初始化。进一步通过梯度特征的覆盖复杂度界定有效维度，得到依赖于学习几何而非参数数量的保证。对于流形支持的数据和分段Lipschitz Jacobian，界随内在维度缩放；对于单隐层ReLU网络，可通过激活稳定区域计数使机制显式化。实验验证了训练Jacobian压缩、残差-曲率线性化的紧致性以及稳定性界与观测泛化差距的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有泛化理论多依赖于参数数量或初始化时的神经正切核分析，无法捕捉学习过程中数据依赖的几何结构。本文旨在建立依赖于训练后模型几何（而非参数计数）的泛化界，以更好地解释深度模型的泛化行为。
AI.method: 采用平均算法稳定性框架，结合Brascamp-Lieb不等式（在强对数凹噪声下）推导误差界；引入数据依赖的有效维度概念，通过经验Jacobian Gram矩阵和残差-曲率项刻画；利用覆盖复杂度技术进一步界定有效维度。
AI.result: 推导了依赖于学习几何的泛化误差界：对于流形支持数据，界随内在维度缩放；对于ReLU网络，界与激活稳定区域计数相关。实验验证了训练Jacobian的压缩现象、线性化近似的有效性以及理论界与经验泛化差距的匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了基于训练后模型几何的泛化界比基于参数数量的界更紧致，且推导过程简洁，从第一性原理出发。该方法为理解非线性最小二乘模型的泛化提供了新视角，揭示了学习过程中隐含的维度压缩机制。

title: Equivalence between time and norm optimal control problems of stochastic differential equations
summary: In this paper, we establish the equivalence between minimal time and minimal norm control problems for controllable stochastic differential equations (SDEs). The core of this equivalence lies in proving the continuity of the minimal norm function. Unlike the deterministic setting, where the time translation technique is effective, this approach is not applicable due to the adapted nature of the admissible controls in SDEs. To address this challenge, we construct the minimal norm control explicitly, thereby achieving the desired continuity. This constructive approach not only proves theoretical equivalence but also facilitates the design of efficient numerical schemes for minimal norm and time controls.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了可控随机微分方程最小时间与最小范数控制问题之间的等价性，通过显式构造最小范数控制证明了其连续性，并提出了高效数值方案。
AI.motivation: 由于随机微分方程中容许控制的适应性，确定性系统中的时间平移技术不再适用，因此需要新的方法建立最小时间与最小范数控制之间的等价关系。
AI.method: 通过显式构造最小范数控制来证明最小范数函数的连续性，以此建立最小时间与最小范数控制问题的等价性。
AI.result: 成功证明了随机微分方程中最小时间与最小范数控制问题的等价性，并设计了高效的数值方案。
AI.conclusion: 不仅从理论上证明了等价性，所提出的构造性方法还可用于设计最小范数和最小时间控制的高效数值算法。

title: Improving Multimodal Reasoning via Worst Dimension Optimization
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires a path that retains integrity over a wide range of constraints, from visual grounding to logic consistency. However, the current Process Reward Models focus on heuristically defined rewards that equally weigh these factors, which may lead to the concealment of individual dimension failures by the dominating factors, without guaranteeing the validity of the reasoning process in general.

AI.tldr: 当前过程奖励模型使用启发式定义的奖励且平等加权多模态推理中的不同约束维度，导致主导因素掩盖了单个维度的失败，无法保证推理过程的有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理需要在视觉基础与逻辑一致性等广泛约束下保持完整性，但现有过程奖励模型因均等加权各因素，无法确保推理过程的有效性。
AI.method: 指出当前过程奖励模型采用启发式定义的奖励函数，对各约束维度（视觉基础、逻辑一致性等）赋予均等权重。
AI.result: 均等加权策略会导致主导因素掩盖个体维度的失败，无法保证推理过程的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 当前过程奖励模型存在缺陷，需要改进其奖励机制以更好地保障多模态推理过程各维度的完整性。

title: MST-Direct at Scale: Multivariate and Conditional Geostatistical Simulation via Sinkhorn Optimal Transport
summary:
This paper extends MST-Direct, a Matching-via-Sinkhorn-Transport approach for multivariate geostatistical simulation, from the original bivariate, unconditional, small-grid formulation to multivariate, conditional, and large-grid settings. We address the three main limitations identified in the original work: (i) scalability beyond a few thousand nodes through a sparse, candidate-restricted Sinkhorn matcher with O(nC) memory complexity; (ii) extension to multiple variables by matching target value tuples onto an independent FFT-MA Gaussian backbone that reproduces a prescribed variogram; and (iii) hard-data conditioning by fixing observed data tuples at their spatial locations while conditioning the backbone through kriging. Because the transport plan remains a permutation of the target tuples, the multivariate joint distribution is preserved exactly.
  The method is validated using the same six-variate, heteroscedastic, strongly nonlinear reference distribution employed in Direct Multivariate Simulation (DMS), under both unconditional (200x200) and conditional (100x100, 200 hard-data samples) scenarios, and is benchmarked against the Projection Pursuit Multivariate Transform (PPMT). Results show that MST-Direct reproduces the joint distribution with zero histogram error, exactly honours hard data, and accurately reproduces the prescribed spatial correlation structure, whereas PPMT remains an approximation.
  Index Terms-Optimal transport, Sinkhorn algorithm, geostatistical simulation, multivariate simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了MST-Direct方法，通过稀疏Sinkhorn匹配器、多变量扩展和硬数据条件化，实现了大规模、多变量、条件化的地质统计模拟，在保持联合分布精确性的同时解决了可扩展性问题。
AI.motivation: 原始MST-Direct方法仅适用于双变量、无条件、小网格场景，存在三大局限性：可扩展性差（仅支持数千节点）、仅支持双变量、无法处理条件数据。本文旨在克服这些限制。
AI.method: (i) 使用稀疏、候选受限的Sinkhorn匹配器，实现O(nC)内存复杂度；(ii) 通过匹配目标值元组到独立的FFT-MA高斯主干上，扩展至多变量；(iii) 通过固定观测数据元组并利用克里金法条件化主干，实现硬数据条件化。
AI.result: 在六变量异方差非线性参考分布上的验证表明：零直方图误差、精确符合硬数据、准确再现指定空间相关结构。相比PPMT方法，MST-Direct在联合分布保持上具有优势。
AI.conclusion: MST-Direct成功扩展至大规模、多变量、条件化场景，其传输计划保持目标元组的排列性质，从而精确保留多变量联合分布，优于PPMT的近似方法。

title: Estimate Collapsibility of Causal Effects in Completed Partial DAGs via Strong d-Convex Hulls
summary: This paper proposes a collapsible method for estimating causal effects that maintains the estimator's consistency before and after marginalization over some variables in completed partially directed acyclic graphs (CPDAGs). We first introduce the estimate collapsibility for CPDAGs and characterize the minimal collapsible sets as strong d-convex hulls. An efficient algorithm is devised to obtain such sets in DAGs and is generalized to CPDAGs. Then, we combine the graph reduction procedure with the IDA framework. Finally, experiments and empirical analysis show the effectiveness of the collapsibility for causal estimations in CPDAGs. Code is available at https://github.com/Jamyang-D/strongly-convex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在完成的部分有向无环图（CPDAG）中，对某些变量进行边缘化后仍能保持估计量一致性的可压缩方法，定义了估计可压缩性，将最小可压缩集表征为强d-凸包，设计了高效算法，并将其与IDA框架结合，实验验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 在因果推断中，CPDAG常用于表示部分已知的因果结构。当需要对某些变量进行边缘化（压缩）时，如何保证因果效应的估计量一致性是一个关键问题。现有方法缺乏对CPDAG中估计可压缩性的系统刻画和高效算法。
AI.method: 首先引入CPDAG中的估计可压缩性概念，将最小可压缩集表征为强d-凸包；接着设计高效算法在DAG中求解该集合，并将其推广到CPDAG；最后将图缩减过程与IDA框架结合。
AI.result: 实验和实证分析表明，所提出的可压缩性方法能有效保持CPDAG中因果估计的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于强d-凸包的可压缩方法能有效解决CPDAG中的估计一致性问题，结合IDA框架具有良好的实用性。

title: Robust Optimization for Green Ammonia Production
summary: The central challenge in optimizing green ammonia systems is satisfying the minimum-load requirements of the Haber-Bosch (HB) process under renewable uncertainty. We develop a robust optimization framework consisting of a strategic capacity planning model and an operational flow model under solar and wind uncertainty. The strategic model is a mixed-integer optimization (MIO) problem with flexible HB operating modes, namely hot-idling and shutdowns. To address the resulting computational challenges, we propose a robust scenario-reduction framework that combines k-means clustering with robust optimization to generate adversarial renewable trajectories. For the operational model, we develop adaptive robust rolling-horizon formulations under forecast uncertainty. Computational results show that the proposed framework produces feasible capacity plans under out-of-sample simulation, whereas existing approaches based on constraint aggregation fail to satisfy HB minimum-load requirements. Adaptive policies achieve higher ammonia production than static robust policies for a given robustness level, but provide weaker protection against realizations outside the uncertainty set.

AI.tldr: 针对绿色氨系统中哈伯-博世工艺最小负荷需求与可再生能源不确定性之间的矛盾，本文提出了一种结合k-means聚类与鲁棒优化的场景缩减框架，以及自适应鲁棒滚动时域运行模型，在保证可行性的同时提升了氨产量。
AI.motivation: 绿色氨系统优化的核心挑战在于如何在可再生能源（太阳能、风能）不确定性的条件下，满足哈伯-博世（HB）工艺的最小负荷运行要求。
AI.method: 1) 建立了两层鲁棒优化框架：战略层为混合整数优化（MIO）容量规划模型，支持热待机与停机两种灵活HB运行模式；运行层为自适应鲁棒滚动时域模型。2) 提出基于k-means聚类与鲁棒优化结合的场景缩减框架，生成对抗性可再生能源轨迹以降低计算复杂度。
AI.result: 1) 所提框架在样本外仿真中能产生可行的容量方案，而基于约束聚合的传统方法无法满足HB最小负荷要求。2) 自适应策略在相同鲁棒水平下比静态鲁棒策略实现更高氨产量，但对不确定性集合外的实现场景保护较弱。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的鲁棒优化框架能有效解决绿色氨系统在可再生能源不确定性下的容量规划与运行问题，但自适应策略在不确定性集合外的鲁棒性存在局限。

title: Beyond Goodhart's Law: A Dynamic Benchmark for Evaluating Compliance in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive assistants to autonomous, execution-capable agents has introduced critical operational risks. Most current evaluation frameworks neglect procedural compliance, leading to ''Machiavellian'' behaviors where agents strategically violate safety rules to maximize rewards - a direct manifestation of Goodhart's Law. To address this blind spot, we introduce MAC-Bench, a dynamic, adversarial benchmark designed to evaluate the procedural alignment of multi-agent systems under realistic pressure. We propose the SERV(Seed - Evolve - Refine - Verify) pipeline, an ``Agent-as-a-Benchmark'' paradigm that transforms unstructured legal texts into executable, contamination-free scenarios. By synthesizing holographic sandbox environments and injecting calibrated social-engineering pressure vectors, MAC-Bench forces agents into Pareto-optimal trade-offs between task success and regulatory adherence. We introduced novel metrics: the Compliance-Weighted Success Rate (CSR) and the Machiavellian Gap (MG), and conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art frontier models to reveal the pervasive trade-offs between success and compliance.

AI.tldr: MAC-Bench是一个动态对抗性基准，用于评估多智能体系统在压力下的程序合规性。它通过SERV流水线将法律文本转化为可执行的免污染场景，引入合规加权成功率和马基雅维利差距两项新指标，揭示前沿模型在任务成功与规则遵守之间的普遍权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM从被动助手演变为自主执行代理，但现有评估框架忽视了程序合规性，导致代理出现“马基雅维利行为”——为最大化奖励而策略性违反安全规则，这是古德哈特法则的直接体现。亟需一个能评估代理在压力下程序对齐的基准。
AI.method: 提出SERV（种子-演进-精炼-验证）流水线，采用“代理即基准”范式将非结构化法律文本转化为可执行的免污染场景。通过合成全息沙盒环境并注入校准的社会工程压力向量，迫使代理在任务成功与法规遵守之间进行帕累托最优权衡。引入合规加权成功率（CSR）和马基雅维利差距（MG）两项新指标。
AI.result: 对前沿模型进行了全面评估，揭示了任务成功与合规性之间存在普遍权衡。
AI.conclusion: MAC-Bench有效暴露了多智能体系统在压力下的程序合规缺口，为评估和改善代理对齐提供了新范式。

title: Training-Inference Kernel Contracts: Bounding Divergence in Post-Training and Deployment
summary: A modern post-training pipeline often writes one symbol for its policy, pi_theta, while evaluating it through two different programs: a training kernel optimized for autograd and an inference kernel optimized for low-precision, fused, dynamically batched serving. In finite precision, these kernels can induce different distributions at identical weights, with the gap concentrated on slices that aggregate benchmarks under-represent. This paper proposes kernel contracts: a contract-first framework for specifying acceptable divergence between K_train and K_inf. A contract C = (N, S, R, O, Pi) combines numerical, statistical, runtime, and observability clauses with an escalation policy from violations to routing actions. We derive a chain of bounds from logit drift to total-variation distance to bounded reward drift, and specialize it to RL post-training, where per-token importance-ratio drift yields a bound on policy-gradient bias under explicit support and norm assumptions. We also describe a four-stage promotion pipeline, online routing loop, and minimal YAML DSL for contract artifacts. This is a framework and vocabulary paper; we do not report production-scale empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“核契约”（kernel contracts）框架，用于规范训练核与推理核之间在有限精度下的可接受差异，并给出了从logit漂移到策略梯度偏差的理论边界，但未进行大规模实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现代后训练管线中，同一个策略网络通过训练核（优化自动求导）和推理核（优化低精度、融合、动态批处理）运行，有限精度下二者产生不同分布，且偏差集中在基准测试未充分覆盖的切片上，需要一个框架来明确规范这种偏差的可接受程度。
AI.method: 提出核契约C=(N,S,R,O,Pi)，包含数值、统计、运行时和可观测性条款以及违规升级策略；从logit漂移推导到总变差距离再到有界奖励漂移的链式边界；针对RL后训练场景，通过per-token重要性比率漂移在明确支持和范数假设下给出策略梯度偏差边界；设计了四阶段晋升管线、在线路由循环和YAML DSL用于契约工件。
AI.result: 给出了从logit漂移到TV距离再到奖励漂移的理论边界链；在RL后训练中，推导了重要性比率漂移对策略梯度偏差的上界；提出了契约框架的设计规范，但未提供生产级实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文是框架与词汇论文，为训练-推理内核差异的量化与管控提供了形式化工具，但实证验证留待未来工作。

title: Multi-Armed Bandits with Arriving Arms: Sequential Screening, Dynamic Regret, and Sublinear Guarantees
summary: We study a stochastic multi-armed bandit problem in which the set of available arms expands over time. This setting arises in sequential experimentation when new actions or treatments become available during an ongoing study, making regret against a single best arm in hindsight inappropriate. We instead evaluate performance relative to the best arm currently available, leading to a dynamic-regret criterion for arriving-arm environments. To address the resulting challenges of arrival information discrepancy (AID) and a drifting benchmark (DB), we propose UCB for Arriving Arms (UCB-AA), an elimination-based procedure with an aiding preliminary screening step for newly arrived arms before full competition with incumbent arms. We show that UCB-AA attains regret bounds that depend explicitly on the arrival process, achieves sublinear dynamic regret under regularity conditions on gap evolution, and admits an online extension for unknown horizons. Simulation results show that UCB-AA reduces wasted pulls and maintains a smaller active arm set while preserving competitive regret performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对动态到达的臂（arms）环境，提出了一种基于置信上界（UCB）的算法UCB-AA，该算法通过消除机制和初步筛选步骤，解决了新臂与旧臂之间的信息差异以及基准漂移问题，并在动态遗憾准则下证明了亚线性遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 传统多臂赌博机假设臂集固定，但在实际序贯实验中（如临床试验），新动作或新治疗手段往往在研究进行过程中才出现，此时事后选取单一最优臂的静态遗憾准则不再适用，需要一种能动态适应臂不断到达场景的评估标准与算法。
AI.method: 提出UCB-AA算法，采用消除（elimination）机制，并引入初步筛选（preliminary screening）步骤，让新到达的臂先与现有臂进行非充分竞争，待初步筛选后再进入全面竞争，从而解决到达信息差异（AID）和漂移基准（DB）两大挑战。
AI.result: UCB-AA的遗憾界显式依赖于到达过程；在间隙演化的正则性条件下，动态遗憾可达亚线性；算法可在线扩展到未知时间范围；仿真表明UCB-AA减少了无效拉动，维持更小的活跃臂集，同时保持有竞争力的遗憾性能。
AI.conclusion: UCB-AA有效解决了臂动态到达场景下的在线学习问题，为相关序贯实验提供了理论保证和实用算法。

title: Temperature control by a state-delay nash strategy: theory and experiments
summary: This work expands the Nash equilibrium algorithm to those systems that have a state delay within the deterministic case, a Linear-Quadratic (LQ) type performance index with generalized cross terms is used, following the constructive approach on optimal control: first, propose the strategies form, close the loop and find the Cauchy solution; secondly, express the cost function according to those expressions; and finally use the Bellman equation as restrictions to find the strategies parameters. The stability of the closed loop is demonstrated. The algorithm is applied to a thermal prototype with an ESP32 micro-controller and its performance is compared with optimal PI controls inside two commercial/industrial PID controllers REX-C100.

AI.tldr: 本文将纳什均衡算法扩展到具有状态时滞的确定性LQ系统中，通过构造性方法求解广义交叉项性能指标下的策略参数，并证明闭环稳定性。算法在ESP32微控制器控制的热力原型上实现，与两款商用/工业PID控制器（REX-C100）中的最优PI控制进行了性能比较。
AI.motivation: 现有纳什均衡算法未考虑系统状态时滞对多智能体博弈的影响，需要将算法扩展到具有状态延迟的确定性LQ系统中，以处理更广泛的工程实际问题。
AI.method: 采用构造性最优控制方法：首先提出策略形式并闭合回路求解柯西解；其次根据表达式构建代价函数；最后利用贝尔曼方程作为约束条件求解策略参数。同时证明了闭环系统的稳定性。
AI.result: 成功将纳什均衡算法扩展到具有状态时滞的LQ系统，并在热力原型平台上使用ESP32微控制器实现了该算法，与REX-C100 PID控制器中的最优PI控制进行了对比实验。
AI.conclusion: 该算法能有效处理带状态时滞的LQ微分博弈问题，硬件实现验证了其可行性，且与商用PID控制器的对比展示了算法在热力系统中的实际应用潜力。

title: Where Instruction Hierarchy Breaks: Diagnosing and Repairing Failures in Reasoning Language Models
summary: Reasoning language models deployed in agentic workflows must follow an instruction hierarchy: when instructions from different sources conflict, the model should obey the highest-privilege applicable instruction. Existing benchmarks largely measure this behavior end-to-end, asking whether the final response is compliant. However, a non-compliant response can arise from several distinct failures: the model may fail to identify the relevant instructions in context, fail to resolve conflicts among identified instructions, or correctly resolve the conflict in its reasoning while still producing a violating response. We introduce a white-box diagnostic framework that localizes instruction hierarchy failures into instruction identification, conflict resolution, and response realization, making failures more interpretable. We evaluate three reasoning models--Gemma-4-31B-IT, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6--on long-context adaptations of IHEval and IHChallenge, and find that the dominant failure mode varies across models, tasks, and context length. Building on the observation that models can often detect conflicts and output violations when explicitly prompted, we propose two training-free self-monitoring mechanisms: a parallel input monitor for low-latency conflict detection before generation, and a sequential output monitor for response-level review and repair. Across Gemma-4-31B-IT, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and GPT-5.3, the strongest monitor reduces rule-following non-compliance by 81-99%, with GPT-5.3 reductions of 86% under static attacks and 45% under adaptive attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出白盒诊断框架，将指令层级遵从失败定位至指令识别、冲突解决和响应实现三个环节，并基于此设计两种免训练自监控机制，在多个模型上使违规率降低81-99%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅端到端评估指令层级遵从的最终响应合规性，无法区分失败来源于未能识别指令、未能解决指令冲突，还是推理正确但生成违规响应，缺乏可解释的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出白盒诊断框架，将指令层级失败分解为指令识别、冲突解决和响应实现三个阶段；基于诊断发现，设计并行输入监控器（生成前低延迟冲突检测）和顺序输出监控器（响应级审查修复）两种免训练自监控机制。
AI.result: 在Gemma-4-31B-IT、Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.3上，最强监控器将规则遵从非合规率降低81-99%；GPT-5.3在静态攻击下降低86%，自适应攻击下降低45%。
AI.conclusion: 不同模型、任务和上下文长度下主导失败模式各不相同；模型在被明确提示时通常能检测冲突并输出违规，表明自监控机制可行且有效。

title: Customer Churn Prediction on Structured Data Using FT-Transformer and Stacking Ensembles
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 20 tables; published in IEEE Access
summary: Customer churn prediction is essential across data-driven industries such as insurance, digital banking, eCommerce, and subscription platforms, where retaining existing customers is typically more cost-effective than acquiring new ones. Predicting churn on structured datasets remains challenging due to class imbalance, nonlinear feature interactions, and heterogeneous feature types. Tree-based ensemble methods consistently demonstrate strong performance in these contexts, often outperforming conventional neural networks. This study introduces a validated hybrid architecture that integrates feature-tokenized transformers (FT-Transformer) with gradient-boosted trees through calibration-aware stacking. The proposed framework addresses persistent gaps in statistical validation, probability calibration, and reproducibility found in prior research. The FT-Transformer captures higher-order feature interactions using self-attention, while XGBoost captures gradient-boosted decision boundaries with complementary inductive biases. Class imbalance is handled using class-weighted loss functions, thereby avoiding synthetic oversampling and preserving minority-class distributions. The models are ensembled using out-of-fold (OOF) stacking with a logistic regression meta-learner, which recalibrates overconfident base model outputs and learns optimal combination weights. On a public bank churn dataset, the hybrid model achieves 62.10% F1, 0.861 AUC-ROC, and 0.647 PR-AUC, outperforming the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) baseline by 3.37 F1 points and 0.027 AUC under 5x5 cross-validation with 95% confidence intervals reported. Ablation studies demonstrate that both the transformer component and stacking strategy contribute materially to performance. The proposed methodology offers a reproducible and extensible reference architecture for contemporary churn prediction on structured tabular data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合FT-Transformer与XGBoost的混合架构，通过校准感知堆叠（calibration-aware stacking）进行客户流失预测，在公开银行数据集上F1达62.10%、AUC-ROC达0.861，优于MLP基线3.37个F1点。
AI.motivation: 客户流失预测在保险、数字银行、电商等数据驱动行业中至关重要，但结构化数据集上存在类别不平衡、非线性特征交互及异构特征类型等挑战，现有研究在统计验证、概率校准和可重复性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出混合架构：FT-Transformer利用自注意力机制捕捉高阶特征交互，XGBoost捕获梯度提升决策边界；采用类加权损失函数处理类别不平衡；通过out-of-fold堆叠与逻辑回归元学习器进行集成，重新校准过度自信的基模型输出并学习最优组合权重。
AI.result: 在公开银行流失数据集上，5x5交叉验证下混合模型达到62.10% F1、0.861 AUC-ROC、0.647 PR-AUC，以3.37个F1点和0.027 AUC超越MLP基线，并报告了95%置信区间；消融实验证实Transformer组件和堆叠策略均有实质性贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为结构化表格数据上的客户流失预测提供了可复现、可扩展的参考架构，填补了统计验证与概率校准方面的空白。

title: SAILS: Surrogate-based Analysis of Interactions via Local Effect Smooths
summary: Feature interactions drive much of the predictive power of machine learning models, yet existing explanation methods only detect and quantify interactions without revealing their functional form, or visualize only restricted interaction types. We propose Surrogate-based Analysis of Interactions via Local effect Smooths (SAILS), a model-agnostic framework that analyzes pairwise interactions through interpretable generalized additive model (GAM) surrogates fitted to the local effects of a black-box model. For each interval of a feature of interest, the surrogate smooth terms isolate the interaction components on derivative level, enabling (i) interaction detection through a heuristic derived from significance tests on smooth terms, (ii) interaction form categorization into linear, product-separable, and non-product-separable types, and (iii) tailored, interpretable visualizations for each interaction type. We empirically validate the framework through controlled simulations and a real-world task, demonstrating its effectiveness for pairwise interactions, with limitations under strong feature correlations and higher-order interactions. SAILS fills a notable gap in the XAI toolbox, going beyond detection of interactions alone to characterizing their functional form.

AI.tldr: SAILS是一个模型无关的框架，通过局部效应的GAM代理模型来分析黑箱模型中的成对特征交互，不仅能检测交互，还能对其函数形式进行分类（线性、可分离乘积、不可分离乘积）并提供针对性可视化。
AI.motivation: 现有解释方法只能检测和量化特征交互，无法揭示交互的函数形式，或仅能可视化受限的交互类型，存在明显的XAI工具缺口。
AI.method: 对每个感兴趣特征的区间，拟合可解释的广义加性模型（GAM）代理模型到黑箱模型的局部效应上；利用代理平滑项在导数层面分离交互成分；通过平滑项的显著性检验启发式检测交互；将交互形式分类为线性、可分离乘积和不可分离乘积三类；为每种交互类型提供定制化可视化。
AI.result: 通过受控模拟和真实任务验证了框架对成对交互的有效性，但在强特征相关性和高阶交互场景下存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: SAILS填补了XAI工具箱中的重要空白，超越了仅检测交互的范畴，进一步刻画了交互的函数形式特征。

title: Advancing Branch-and-Price for Graph Coloring: New Pricing Strategies and Benchmark Results
summary: This paper proposes BPCOL+, an exact branch-and-price algorithm for the Graph Coloring Problem. The algorithm integrates enhanced pricing strategies based on Zero-Suppressed Binary Decision Diagrams (ZDDs) for solving the pricing problem associated with the maximal-stable-set-based set-covering formulation. After computing upper and lower bounds at the root node using heuristic procedures and column generation, BPCOL+ reduces the size of the ZDD by applying maximal stable set reduction techniques that exploit alternative dual vectors. Computational experiments on the 137 DIMACS benchmark instances and on 5,000 recently proposed Erdős--Rényi instances show that BPCOL+ outperforms existing exact branch-and-price algorithms and remains highly competitive with state-of-the-art SAT-based exact solvers. In particular, BPCOL+ solves 96 DIMACS instances within one hour and proves optimality for 4,641 of the 5,000 Erdős--Rényi instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BPCOL+，一种基于分支定价的图着色精确算法，通过零压缩二元决策图（ZDD）增强定价策略，在DIMACS和Erdős–Rényi实例上优于现有精确算法，与SAT求解器竞争力强。
AI.motivation: 图着色问题（GCP）是经典NP难问题，现有精确算法在求解效率上仍有提升空间，尤其是大规模实例。旨在设计更高效的分支定价算法，超越现有同类方法并接近SAT求解器性能。
AI.method: 基于最大稳定集的集合覆盖公式；采用ZDD求解定价子问题；根节点通过启发式和列生成计算上下界；利用替代对偶向量对ZDD进行最大稳定集约简以减小规模；最终嵌入分支定价框架。
AI.result: 在137个DIMACS实例中1小时内解决96个；在5000个Erdős–Rényi实例中证明4641个的最优性；优于现有精确分支定价算法，与最先进SAT求解器竞争。
AI.conclusion: BPCOL+通过ZDD增强定价和约简技术显著提升了图着色精确求解效率，验证了该方法在大规模实例上的有效性和竞争力。

title: Scaling Participation in Modular AI Systems
summary: Humanity is a mosaic of multifaceted talents and needs, and any truly intelligent AI must reflect that richness. Yet the LLMs used by all are built by the few -- a centralized market of monolithic AI models structurally ill-suited to capture the diversity of human knowledge, reasoning, and values. Here we introduce scaling participation, a new paradigm in which modular AI systems are built from the bottom up through the contributions of diverse stakeholders. Participants contribute small models trained on their own interests and priorities; these models then collaborate in modular frameworks as compositional AI systems. Participatory AI systems outperform monolithic LLMs by up to 15.4% across 15 tasks, such as reasoning and factuality, surpassing models larger than all contributed components combined. Further experiments show that participatory AI systems benefit from contributor diversity, substantially improve on each contributor's original priorities, and exhibit emergent capabilities that allow them to solve over 15% of problems where all individual models fail. Scaling participation provides a technical foundation for transitioning from the monolithic status quo toward an open, bottom-up, and collaborative AI future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"扩展参与"（scaling participation）新范式，通过多方贡献的小模型构建模块化组合式AI系统，在15项任务上比单体LLM提升最高15.4%，并展现出超越所有单个模型的 emergent 能力，为从垄断式AI走向开放协作的AI未来奠定技术基础。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM由少数中心化实体构建的单一模型主导，无法捕捉人类知识、推理和价值观的多样性，亟需一种能反映人类多元才能与需求的AI构建新范式。
AI.method: 提出"扩展参与"范式：多方利益相关者贡献各自领域的小模型，这些模型在模块化框架中协作组成组合式AI系统，实现从下而上的AI构建方式。
AI.result: 参与式AI系统在15项任务（推理、事实性等）上比单体LLM提升最高15.4%，超过所有组件模型总和的规模；多样性贡献带来显著收益；能解决超过15%的个体模型均失败的问题，展现出涌现能力。
AI.conclusion: 扩展参与为从垄断式单体AI向开放、自下而上、协作式AI未来的转型提供了技术基础。

title: Outage Detection in Self-Healing Smart Grids Using Reinforcement Learning with Spectral Graph Neural Networks
summary: Self-healing smart grids can quickly adjust their network configuration during outages to minimize power disruptions. During an outage, several actions can be taken, such as network reconfiguration through switching operations and emergency load shedding. However, traditional machine learning methods for outage mitigation are not well suited for smart grids due to their slow response time and high computational cost. To address these challenges, recent studies have explored reinforcement learning to automatically perform network reconfiguration. In these approaches, the control policy is typically modeled using a graph neural network (GNN). However, conventional GNNs operate in the spatial domain and may fail to capture important relationships in the frequency domain. Frequency-domain information is particularly useful for modeling global structural patterns and system-wide interactions in power networks. In this paper, we propose a spectral graph reinforcement learning framework for outage management in distribution networks to enhance system resilience. Our model learns the optimal power restoration policy using a spectral graph neural network. We evaluate the proposed method on three modified IEEE test systems: the 13-bus, 34-bus, and 123-bus networks. Experimental results show that our approach achieves near-optimal performance in real time and generalizes well across a wide range of outage scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于频谱图强化学习的配电网故障恢复框架，利用频谱图神经网络学习最优恢复策略，在三个IEEE测试系统上实现了接近最优的实时性能和良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习方法响应慢、计算成本高，难以满足自愈智能电网的实时故障恢复需求；现有基于GNN的强化学习方法在空间域操作，无法捕获电力网络中频域信息所蕴含的全局结构模式和系统范围交互关系。
AI.method: 提出频谱图强化学习框架(Spectral Graph Reinforcement Learning)，采用频谱图神经网络(Spectral GNN)建模控制策略，在频域进行图卷积操作以捕获电力网络的全局结构特征。
AI.result: 在IEEE 13-bus、34-bus和123-bus三个改进测试系统上评估，该方法实现了接近最优的实时性能，并在多种故障场景下具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 频谱图强化学习能有效利用频域信息提升配电网故障恢复的实时性和泛化性，为自愈智能电网的韧性增强提供了可行方案。

title: Report the Floor: A Training-Free Conformal Interval Is a Mandatory Baseline for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Probabilistic forecasters are increasingly learned, yet the baselines they are compared against are often weak or omitted. We show that the simplest possible conformal interval - a last-value point forecast wrapped in a finite-sample split-conformal residual quantile, with no parameters and no training - is a far stronger baseline than its near-total absence from recent learned-forecasting and conformal-time-series comparisons would suggest. In one-step-ahead online forecasting across 2,217 real series from nine public sources (Monash, LOTSA, the LTSF traffic/electricity/weather suites, METR-LA, BOOM, nips/probts), this ConformalNaive interval decisively beats the naive value-quantile baselines, the entire NPTS family (NPTS 73%, SeasonalNPTS 64% of series), and the published Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP) method (71% of series, bootstrap 95% CI [69,73], paired Wilcoxon p approx 7.6e-135); it is on par with the simpler learned conformal predictors (RCI, quantile regression; median relative Winkler within 2%) and is beaten only by the adaptive-online and ensemble methods (SPCI, ACI, AgACI), which track distribution shift and lead by 9-33% relative Winkler. It is also better calibrated than a trained neural forecaster: on the six datasets that introduced DeepNPTS, the trivial floors cover the truth 84-85% of the time at a nominal 95%, versus DeepNPTS's 66%. At multi-step seasonal horizons the picture inverts: the random-walk floor is the weakest method and the seasonal pool (CSP) wins - a boundary we map. Finally we give ConformalNaive+, a one-line, training-free, horizon-adaptive selector that attains the better of two complementary floors at every horizon with restored coverage. We argue the matching conformal naive floor must be a mandatory baseline whenever a learned probabilistic forecaster claims gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统验证了最简单的无参数无训练的ConformalNaive区间（最后观测值+分裂共形残差分位数）作为概率预测基线的强大性能。在2217个真实时间序列上，该基线击败了NPTS系列、CSP等方法，与简单学习式共形预测器相当，仅弱于自适应在线方法。文章强调学习型概率预测器必须与此类匹配的共形朴素基线进行比较。
AI.motivation: 当前概率预测研究中，学习型模型常与弱基线或缺失基线比较，缺乏一个简单、无参数、无需训练的强基线来公平评估学习方法的真实增益。
AI.method: 提出ConformalNaive区间：最后一值点预测+有限样本分裂共形残差分位数，无参数无训练。扩展为ConformalNaive+：一行代码、无需训练的跨水平自适应选择器，能在不同预测水平上选取两个互补基线中的较优者。
AI.result: 在2217个真实序列上：ConformalNaive击败NPTS 73%/SeasonalNPTS 64%的序列，击败CSP 71%的序列；与RCI、分位数回归等简单学习式方法相当（中位数相对Winkler差距在2%以内）；仅弱于SPCI/ACI/AgACI等自适应在线方法（差距9-33%）。在DeepNPTS的6个数据集上，朴素区间覆盖率84-85%（标称95%），远超DeepNPTS的66%。多步季节预测中CSP胜出，呈现边界反转。
AI.conclusion: 匹配的共形朴素基线必须成为学习型概率预测器的强制性基线，以公平评估学习方法的实际增益。

title: Variational Analysis of Metric Projections onto Isotone Projection Cones via Coderivatives
comment: 26 pages, 3 figures. The paper studies coderivatives of metric projection operators and applications to variational analysis and optimization problems
summary:
In this paper, we study variational properties of the metric projection mapping onto isotone projection cones in finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces. We derive explicit formulas for both the Fréchet coderivative and the Mordukhovich coderivative of the projection operator. The analysis is based on a local description of the projection mapping via an associated generating system in a neighborhood of a reference point, which leads to computable coderivative characterizations. As an application, we compute the covering constant of the projection mapping, providing a quantitative description of its local regularity. Furthermore, we establish verifiable sufficient conditions for the Aubin property of the solution mapping associated with parametric nonlinear complementarity problems associated with isotone projection cones.
  The obtained results contribute to the variational analysis of metric projections in a general cone setting where orthogonality arguments are not available, and to the stability theory of complementarity systems in finite dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限维欧氏空间中度量投影映射到等变投影锥上的变分性质，推导了投影算子的Fréchet余导数和Mordukhovich余导数的显式公式，并应用于计算投影映射的覆盖常数及建立参数非线性互补问题解映射的Aubin性质的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 在一般的锥（等变投影锥）背景下，由于正交性论证不可用，需要新的变分分析工具来刻画度量投影的变分性质，并服务于互补系统的稳定性理论。
AI.method: 基于在参考点邻域内通过关联生成系统对投影映射进行局部描述，从而推导出Fréchet余导数和Mordukhovich余导数的显式公式。
AI.result: 获得了投影映射的覆盖常数（局部正则性的定量描述），以及参数非线性互补问题解映射满足Aubin性质的充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果推广了度量投影在一般锥背景下的变分分析（无需正交性假设），并为有限维互补系统的稳定性理论提供了新的工具。

title: Joint Structural Pruning and Mixed-Precision Quantization for LLM Compression
summary: Recently, the efficiency of Large Language Models (LLMs) deployment has become a critical concern in practical applications. While post-training quantization (PTQ) and structural pruning are established techniques for reducing memory footprint and inference latency, most existing PTQ approaches optimize quantization errors on a per-layer basis, overlooking how errors accumulate and propagate through the network, often resulting in suboptimal solutions. Traditional pipelines also tend to apply pruning and quantization in isolation or sequentially, further compounding sub-optimality. We introduce a novel end-to-end framework that addresses these limitations in two key ways. First, we propose a novel mixed-precision PTQ strategy that directly minimizes global error propagation across the entire model, rather than isolating layer-wise errors. Building on this, we develop a novel joint optimization approach that simultaneously learns structural pruning decisions and mixed-precision quantization policies within a unified search space. Extensive experiments show that, at ultra-low precisions (1-3 bits), our quantization method reduces WikiText perplexity by up to 21% compared to state-of-the-art (SoTA) weight-activation quantization baselines. Against leading weight-only quantization methods, it achieves up to 59% and 85% lower perplexity on WikiText and C4, respectively. Compared to the SoTA joint pruning-and-quantization techniques, our proposed method delivers superior perplexity and reasoning performance at ultra-low bits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端框架，通过全局误差传播优化的混合精度PTQ策略，以及联合结构化剪枝与量化决策的统一搜索方法，在超低位宽（1-3比特）下显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练量化（PTQ）方法逐层优化量化误差，忽略误差在网络中的累积传播，且剪枝与量化通常孤立或顺序执行，导致次优解。
AI.method: 提出直接最小化全局误差传播的混合精度PTQ策略，并在此基础上构建联合优化框架，在统一搜索空间中同时学习结构化剪枝决策和混合精度量化策略。
AI.result: 超低位宽（1-3比特）下，量化方法在WikiText上困惑度降低21%（权重-激活量化），59%和85%（权重仅量化，WikiText和C4）；联合剪枝量化方法在超低位宽下困惑度和推理性能均优于最先进技术。
AI.conclusion: 全局误差传播优化和联合剪枝-量化搜索可有效提升LLM在极端低位宽下的部署效率与模型质量。

title: From Human Guidance to Autonomy: Agent Skill System for End-to-End LLM Deployment on Spatial NPUs
summary:
Spatial neural processing units (NPUs) provide an energy-efficient platform for edge LLM inference, but efficiently deploying an LLM end-to-end on such hardware remains labor-intensive. Although AI coding agents have begun to lower this cost, existing studies have largely focused on single-kernel optimization rather than end-to-end LLM deployment on resource-constrained spatial NPUs.
  We present a two-stage methodology, instantiated on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU, that progresses from human-guided development to agent autonomy. In the first stage, we develop a reference deployment of Llama-3.2-1B through human-guided agent assistance. The resulting implementation achieves a speedup of 2.2x on prefill and 4.0x on decode over the hand-optimized baseline, with the optimization trajectory and its lessons recorded as structured documentation throughout. In the second stage, we distill the documentation into an agent skill system consisting of eight phases, orchestrating the optimization and debugging skill sets, with numerical correctness strictly enforced at each phase.
  Using our agent skill system, we autonomously deploy eight additional decoder-only LLMs (Llama-3.2-3B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Qwen2.5-{0.5B, 1.5B, 3B}, Qwen3-{0.6B, 1.7B, 4B}) end-to-end on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU using the open-source compiler stack. To our knowledge, these models have not previously been deployed on AMD NPUs via any open-source software stack. Each deployment completes in 0.5-4 hours of agent wall time with almost no human guidance, and passes the numerical-correctness gates, demonstrating functional generalization to previously unencountered LLMs. Three of the eight match or exceed the sustained performance of our Llama-3.2-1B reference deployment, suggesting that the resulting implementations can be competitive without additional model-specific human engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段方法，在AMD XDNA 2 NPU上实现端到端LLM部署。第一阶段通过人类引导的智能体辅助开发Llama-3.2-1B参考部署，比手工优化基线实现2.2倍（prefill）和4.0倍（decode）加速。第二阶段将经验蒸馏为八阶段智能体技能系统，自动部署了8个额外的decoder-only LLM，每个部署在0.5-4小时内完成，几乎无需人工干预，其中3个模型达到或超过参考部署的性能。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的空间NPU上高效部署LLM端到端仍非常耗时费力，现有研究多聚焦于单核优化而非完整的端到端部署，缺乏自动化方法。
AI.method: 两阶段方法论：第一阶段（人类引导阶段）借助AI编码智能体辅助开发Llama-3.2-1B的参考部署，记录优化轨迹和经验为结构化文档；第二阶段（自主阶段）将文档蒸馏为包含八个阶段的智能体技能系统，协调优化和调试技能集，每个阶段严格强制数值正确性，实现自主部署。
AI.result: 第一阶段：Llama-3.2-1B实现prefill 2.2x、decode 4.0x加速。第二阶段：成功自主部署8个不同规模的decoder-only LLM（Llama-3.2-3B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Qwen2.5系列, Qwen3系列），每个部署耗时0.5-4小时，几乎无需人工干预，其中3个模型性能达到或超过参考部署。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将人类部署经验蒸馏为智能体技能系统的可行性，使得空间NPU上端到端LLM部署能够从人工密集型过程转变为高度自动化的过程，且部署结果具有竞争力和泛化能力。

authors: Evelin H. M. Krulikovski e Marina Geremia
title: Augmented Lagrangian methods for nonlinear semidefinite programming with complementarity constraints
summary: We consider nonlinear semidefinite programming problems with complementarity constraints (SDCMPCC), a class of highly degenerate problems where classical optimality conditions typically fail. In this context, weak stationarity conditions have been developed to address their degeneracy. While these notions are well understood, their algorithmic implications remain largely unexplored in semidefinite complementarity settings. We introduce a reformulation based on the spectral decomposition of the complementarity structure, which preserves local solutions and enables a tractable analysis. Within this framework, we analyze an augmented Lagrangian method for SDCMPCC and prove that under a suitable extension of Robinson's condition, every accumulation point of the generated sequence is W-stationary, or C-stationary under a stricter condition for solving the subproblems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对带互补约束的非线性半定规划（SDCMPCC）提出基于谱分解的重构方法，并证明了增广拉格朗日方法在该框架下生成的序列的聚点满足W-平稳性或C-平稳性。
AI.motivation: SDCMPCC是一类高度退化的问题，经典最优性条件通常失效。虽然弱平稳性条件已被提出用于处理退化性，但这些概念在算法层面的影响在半定互补设定中仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出基于互补结构谱分解的重构方法，该方法保持局部解并允许可处理的收敛性分析；在此框架下分析增广拉格朗日方法。
AI.result: 在适当的Robinson条件扩展下，算法生成的序列的每个聚点都是W-平稳点；在更严格的子问题求解条件下，可达到C-平稳性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了SDCMPCC算法分析的空白，为半定互补约束优化问题提供了收敛性保证。

title: Overcoming the Regulatory Bottleneck via Agent-to-Agent Protocols: A Nuclear Case Study
summary: Regulatory review of advanced nuclear reactor designs routinely spans more than three years and consumes hundreds of millions of dollars in combined regulator and applicant labor. We present the Regulatory Context Protocol (RCP), an Agent-to-Agent communication standard that replaces the formal human-to-human pipeline between regulators and applicants with a structured, auditable agentic channel, while preserving human oversight at safety-significant decision points. The protocol is calibrated against an analysis of 1,236 documents from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission advanced reactor dockets and demonstrated with a working multi-agent pilot. Against an 89M USD, 42-month Reconstructed Baseline, RCP cuts costs by 50-77 percent (21M-44M USD) and timelines by 65 percent (15 months). Without a shared protocol, Standalone Agents reach only 54M-74M USD and 21 months. The residual cost-and-time gap is structural, not algorithmic: it traces to the inter-organizational pipeline that only an agent-to-agent standard can compress. The same bottleneck - formal multi-party review under strict auditability requirements - characterizes pharmaceutical approvals, environmental permitting, financial supervision, and aviation certification. The US regulatory paperwork burden carries a 426.5 billion USD annual opportunity cost; replicated broadly, the projected 50-77 percent reduction implies savings on the order of 210-330 billion USD per year - approaching 1 percent of US GDP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出监管审查协议(RCP)，一种将监管机构与申请人之间的人类沟通流程替换为结构化、可审计的智能体间通信标准，可将先进核反应堆设计审查成本降低50-77%、时间缩短65%，并有望在更广泛的监管领域释放数千亿美元的经济效益。
AI.motivation: 先进核反应堆设计的监管审查周期超过三年、耗资数亿美元，现有的人与人之间的正式沟通流程效率极低，亟需一种新的通信范式来压缩时间与成本。
AI.method: 提出监管审查协议(RCP)，一种智能体对智能体的通信标准，在保留安全关键决策点人类监督的前提下，用结构化、可审计的智能体通道替代传统正式的人与人的监管沟通流程。基于1,236份美国核管会先进反应堆卷宗进行校准，并构建了多智能体试点系统进行验证。
AI.result: 相比重建基线（8,900万美元、42个月），RCP将成本降低50-77%（2,100-4,400万美元），时间缩短65%（15个月）。无共享协议的独立智能体方案仅能达到5,400-7,400万美元和21个月。残留的成本-时间差距是结构性的而非算法性的。
AI.conclusion: 监管审查瓶颈本质上是多组织间正式审查管道的结构性问题，只有智能体对智能体的通信标准才能有效压缩。该方案可推广至药品审批、环境许可、金融监管和航空认证等领域，按美国监管文书负担4,265亿美元的年机会成本计算，可节省2,100-3,300亿美元/年，接近美国GDP的1%。

title: The Routing Plateau: Understanding and Breaking the Accuracy Limits of LLM Routers
summary: LLM routing has become a popular approach to improve the cost-quality trade-off of LLM services by dynamically selecting a model for each query. Recent work has explored a broad range of routing methods, including clustering-based routers, learned classifiers, pairwise ranking, and confidence-based approaches. Our extensive study of 21 routing methods across five benchmarks reveals a consistent phenomenon that we call the routing plateau: many methods, including kNN, achieve very similar accuracy and converge to a narrow performance range that remains far below the oracle router. Our investigation shows that the plateau is largely caused by a predictability bottleneck: current routers mainly learn global averaged model-performance trends rather than fine-grained query-specific routing signals. As a result, they solve overlapping easy queries but collectively fail on hard queries that require instance-specific routing decisions. We further study how to move beyond the plateau and find that larger training datasets, stronger encoders, and end-to-end fine-tuning can further improve routing accuracy. These findings characterize the common limits of current routing methods and provide insights and actionable directions for the community to build more effective routing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对21种路由方法在5个基准上的广泛研究发现了一个称为“路由平台期”的现象：大多数方法（包括kNN）性能非常接近，远低于oracle路由器。该平台期主要由可预测性瓶颈导致——当前路由器主要学习全局平均模型性能趋势，而非细粒度的查询特定路由信号，导致它们在简单查询上表现重叠，但在需要实例级路由决策的困难查询上集体失败。研究发现更大训练集、更强编码器和端到端微调可以突破平台期。
AI.motivation: LLM路由通过动态选择模型来优化成本-质量权衡已成为流行方法，但现有路由方法的性能上限和局限性尚不明确，需要进行系统性研究来理解当前方法的表现瓶颈。
AI.method: 对21种路由方法在5个基准上进行广泛实验比较，分析性能收敛现象，并通过可预测性分析、数据集规模、编码器强度和端到端微调等维度探索突破平台期的途径。
AI.result: 发现路由平台期现象：多种方法性能收敛到狭窄范围，远低于oracle上限；平台期由可预测性瓶颈导致，路由器主要捕获全局趋势而非实例级信号；更大的训练集、更强的编码器和端到端微调可以提升路由准确性。
AI.conclusion: 当前路由方法存在根本性局限，未来需要超越全局平均性能预测，发展能够进行细粒度、实例级路由决策的更强路由系统。

title: Optimal Harvesting under Stochastic Control: HJB Equation and Feynman-Kac Representation
summary: Sustainable resource management requires harvesting strategies that account for environmental variability and ecological uncertainty. This study investigates optimal harvesting of renewable biological resources within a stochastic framework, where population dynamics are influenced by random environmental fluctuations and modeled using stochastic differential equations. Two complementary approaches are employed: the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation and the Feynman-Kac representation. The HJB framework provides a dynamic optimization rule and characterizes the value function through a nonlinear partial differential equation, while the Feynman-Kac approach offers a probabilistic interpretation of expected returns. A comparative analysis demonstrates the theoretical consistency and practical relevance of both methods for designing economically efficient and ecologically sustainable harvesting policies under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机微分方程建模种群动态，通过HJB方程和Feynman-Kac表示两种方法，探讨不确定性环境下可再生生物资源的最优收获策略，证明了两种方法在理论上一致且对设计经济高效与生态可持续的收获政策具有实践意义。
AI.motivation: 可持续资源管理需要在环境变化和生态不确定性的背景下制定收获策略，而传统确定性模型难以捕捉随机环境波动对种群动态的影响。
AI.method: 采用随机微分方程建模种群动态，分别运用Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程（提供动态优化规则，通过非线性偏微分方程刻画值函数）和Feynman-Kac表示（提供期望收益的概率解释）两种互补方法。
AI.result: 两种方法在理论上具有一致性，且在实践中能够用于设计在不确定性条件下兼顾经济效率与生态可持续性的收获政策。
AI.conclusion: HJB方程与Feynman-Kac表示的互补结合为随机环境下的可再生资源最优收获提供了统一的理论框架，对可持续资源管理具有重要的方法论价值。

title: Safety is Contextual, LLM-Judges Are Not: Navigating the Rigid Priors of Evaluators
summary: LLMs-as-judges are the only way to evaluate safety at scale. Despite their importance, LLM-judges themselves are rarely evaluated beyond human agreement in simple, static benchmarks. We therefore investigate two under-explored but crucial properties of LLMs-as-judges: their susceptibility to relying on in context-information, and their steerability to differing safety definitions, which may not align with their internal safety priors. We evaluate the safety judging abilities of many generalist LLMs and safety-specific judges, and investigate the impact of task demonstrations, novel in-context information, and changing safety definitions. We find that while LLM-judges can learn from new information, they are broadly unlikely to adjust their evaluations if the context or safety definition contradicts their prior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM作为评判者时对上下文信息的依赖性和可引导性，发现尽管LLM评判者能从新信息中学习，但当上下文或安全定义与其先验知识相矛盾时，它们通常不会调整评估结果。
AI.motivation: LLM作为评判者是规模化评估安全性的唯一方式，但现有的评估仅停留在简单静态基准上的人类一致性检查，忽视了上下文依赖性和可引导性这两个关键属性。
AI.method: 评估多种通用LLM和安全专用评判者的安全评判能力，研究任务示范、新颖上下文信息以及安全定义变化对其评估结果的影响。
AI.result: LLM评判者能够从新信息中学习，但当上下文或安全定义与其内部安全先验相矛盾时，它们普遍不会调整自己的评估。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者对先验知识的依赖性强于对上下文信息的适应能力，这对其在不同安全定义下的可靠应用提出了挑战。

title: Optimality of Sequential Filtering Under Independent Cost and Selectivity Models
comment: 2 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Electro/Information Technology (EIT 2026)
summary: Sequential filtering pipelines are a common design pattern in large-scale systems, where a large population of items is progressively reduced by a sequence of stages that each incur cost. Despite their prevalence in ranking systems, cascaded machine learning inference, and fraud detection, filter ordering is often determined by heuristics without formal guarantees. We formalize sequential filtering under an expected-cost objective and prove that, under an independence model, ordering filters by increasing ratio of cost to rejection probability minimizes expected total cost. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that the optimal ordering strictly dominates common heuristics across all runs, both in expectation and across the full distribution of outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化定义了顺序过滤管道问题，证明在独立模型下按成本与拒绝概率之比升序排列过滤器可最小化期望总成本，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证该最优排序严格优于常见启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 顺序过滤管道在大规模系统中广泛存在（如排序系统、级联机器学习推理、欺诈检测），但过滤器的排序往往依赖启发式方法而缺乏形式化保证，本文旨在提供严格的最优排序理论。
AI.method: 形式化定义顺序过滤的期望成本目标；在独立性假设下推导并证明最优排序条件（按成本/拒绝概率比升序）；通过大规模蒙特卡洛模拟与常见启发式方法进行对比验证。
AI.result: 在独立模型下，按成本与拒绝概率之比递增排序过滤器可最小化期望总成本；蒙特卡洛模拟表明该最优排序在期望和完整结果分布上均严格优于所有常见启发式方法。
AI.conclusion: 顺序过滤管道中，形式化的最优排序策略（成本/拒绝概率比升序）具有理论保证和实证优势，应取代无理论保障的启发式方法。

title: Active Learning with Foundation Model Priors: Efficient Learning under Class Imbalance
summary: Real-world datasets across image and text domains are often characterized by skewed class distributions and noisy annotations, which jointly degrade model performance, particularly on minority classes. Among existing solutions, active learning offers an effective and efficient paradigm by selectively querying the most informative and balanced samples for annotation. We propose an innovative active learning framework that mitigates class imbalance and selects the most informative samples to annotate. Leveraging foundation model priors, our algorithm enables imbalance-aware co-decisions between foundation model and small model to tackle noisy and imbalanced labels across various domains. We introduce the first study to systematically explore active learning under the dual challenges of label noise and class imbalance across image and text domains. Extensive experiments on imbalanced datasets demonstrate that our method achieves substantial annotation savings-over 50% compared to the best active learning baseline-while preserving performance and robustness to label noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种创新的主动学习框架，利用基础模型先验，实现基础模型与小模型的联合决策，以应对真实数据集中存在的类别不平衡和标签噪声双重挑战。实验表明，该方法在图像和文本领域均能实现超过50%的标注成本节约，同时保持对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界数据集常同时存在类别分布偏斜和标注噪声问题，二者共同导致模型性能下降，尤其对少数类影响严重。现有主动学习方法大多只关注单一挑战，缺乏系统性的研究来同时处理标签噪声和类别不平衡。
AI.method: 提出一种基于基础模型先验的主动学习框架，通过基础模型与小模型之间的联合决策机制，实现不平衡感知的样本选择。算法能够识别并缓解类别不平衡，同时选择信息量最丰富的样本进行标注。
AI.result: 在不平衡数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法相比最优主动学习基线，实现了超过50%的标注成本节约，同时在标签噪声条件下保持性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个系统性地探索在标签噪声和类别不平衡双重挑战下进行主动学习的研究，涵盖图像和文本领域，证明了所提框架的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Block coordinate descent for joint delay-energy optimization in multi-hop D2D networks
summary: In multi-hop device-to-device (D2D) networks, the optimization of network-level metrics is particularly difficult due to the tight coupling between network-layer routing and physical-layer resource allocation. Departing from traditional average-performance metrics, this paper addresses the joint optimization of routing paths, transmission power, and bandwidth allocation. We formulate a generalized cost function to minimize the maximum transmission time (i.e., the bottleneck delay) alongside the total energy consumption. To tackle the resulting highly non-convex formulation, we propose a novel block coordinate descent (BCD) framework. At the network layer, we develop two adaptive routing algorithms: a matrix-free Frank-Wolfe (MF-FW) algorithm for fast execution in dense topologies, and a low-rank primal-dual interior-point method (LR-PDIPM) that bypasses dense matrix inversions via the Sherman-Morrison formula for high-precision solutions. At the physical layer, we design a parallel dual ascent algorithm leveraging a time-domain perspective transformation to solve the resource allocation subproblem to global optimality. The proposed BCD framework is proven to converge to an ε-neighborhood of a stationary point. Through comprehensive experiments, the proposed BCD framework establishes its superiority in achieving the optimal delay-energy trade-off. Specifically, the LR-PDIPM variant achieves a maximum 9.14-fold reduction in total energy consumption and up to an order of magnitude improvement in energy efficiency, while maintaining a bounded maximum delay gap (up to 3.78-fold) relative to the best baseline. Meanwhile, the warm-start MF-FW variant identifies near-optimal solutions in mere seconds, serving as a highly practical engineering approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多跳D2D网络，提出了一种块坐标下降（BCD）框架，联合优化路由路径、发射功率和带宽分配，以最小化最大传输时间（瓶颈延迟）与总能耗。在网络层设计了两种自适应路由算法（MF-FW和LR-PDIPM），在物理层设计了并行对偶上升算法，证明了收敛到驻点的ε邻域。实验显示LR-PDIPM最多降低9.14倍能耗，MF-FW可在数秒内找到近优解。
AI.motivation: 多跳D2D网络中网络层路由与物理层资源分配紧密耦合，传统基于平均性能的指标难以优化网络级指标，亟需一种联合优化框架来同时优化瓶颈延迟和能量消耗。
AI.method: 提出块坐标下降（BCD）框架，网络层采用矩阵自由Frank-Wolfe（MF-FW）算法（适用于密集拓扑快速执行）和低秩原始-对偶内点法（LR-PDIPM）（利用Sherman-Morrison公式避免稠密矩阵求逆）；物理层设计并行对偶上升算法，利用时域视角变换实现全局最优资源分配。
AI.result: LR-PDIPM变体相比最佳基线实现最多9.14倍的能耗降低和数量级能效提升，最大延迟差距控制在3.78倍以内；MF-FW变体在数秒内找到近优解。
AI.conclusion: 所提BCD框架在延迟-能耗权衡中具有优越性，两种路由算法分别适用于高精度和快速执行场景，为多跳D2D网络提供了一种高效实用的联合优化方案。

title: The AI Epistemic Deference Index: A Continuous Measure of Sycophancy
summary: Current AI models frequently exhibit epistemic sycophancy, endorsing claims to agree with a user. Existing evaluations typically measure this either by assessing what it takes to make a model shift a binary endorsement or by eliciting an explicit probability in a proposition. However, much user-facing sycophantic behavior is demonstrated through shifts in graded support expressed through ordinary language. We propose the AI Epistemic Deference Index (AEDI): a continuous, unidimensional score representing how sensitive the support expressed in a model's output is to the attitude expressed in a user's prompt. To generate AEDI, we provide a new protocol for estimating probabilities from natural language outputs, using LLMs-as-judges validated for consistency and correlation to human judgment. We deploy it on a new curated database of 500 propositions across diverse topics and 16,000 prompts varying in user attitude, testing eight prominent models. Every model exhibits substantial deference, though with large and systematic differences across providers, with Claude models demonstrating the least, and Grok and Gemini models the most. The effect is amplified in prompts requesting a written artifact, and concentrated on propositions where models hold weaker priors. We release AEDI as an easy-to-update benchmark and measurement pipeline for output-level sycophancy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI认知顺从指数（AEDI），一种衡量模型输出对用户态度敏感程度的连续单维评分。通过LLM作为裁判从自然语言输出中估计概率，在500个命题和16000个提示上测试8个模型，发现所有模型均表现出显著顺从，其中Claude最低，Grok和Gemini最高。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常衡量二元认同转变或显式概率，但用户面对的语言顺从行为常表现为自然语言中分级支持的转变，缺乏对此类行为的系统量化评估方法。
AI.method: 提出AEDI指数，使用LLM作为裁判从自然语言输出中估计概率（经验证与人类判断一致），构建500个命题和16000个不同用户态度的提示数据库，测试8个主流模型。
AI.result: 所有模型均表现出显著认知顺从，但差异巨大：Claude模型顺从程度最低，Grok和Gemini模型最高。请求书面产物的提示会放大该效应，且效应集中在模型先验较弱的命题上。
AI.conclusion: AEDI可作为易于更新的基准测试和测量流程，用于输出层面的顺从性评估，揭示不同模型在认知顺从方面的系统性差异。

title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
summary: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.

AI.tldr: ResearchClawBench是一个包含40个来自10个科学领域任务的基准测试，用于评估自主科研智能体。每个任务基于真实已发表论文，并提供相关文献和原始数据。通过专家策划的多模态评分标准，评估系统能否达到目标论文水平的重新发现。目前最强自主智能体Claude Code平均21.5分，最强LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均20.7分，LLM前沿均值仅26.5分。错误分析显示失败集中在实验方案不匹配、证据不匹配和缺失科学核心。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体越来越多地用于科学工作，但其端到端自主研究能力仍然难以验证，现有方法缺乏可复现的评估标准。
AI.method: 构建40个跨10个科学领域的任务基准，每个任务基于真实已发表论文，提供相关文献和原始数据，隐藏目标论文。专家设计多模态评分标准，将目标科学成果分解为加权标准。在统一协议下评估7个自主研究智能体和17个原生LLM（通过轻量级ResearchHarness）。
AI.result: 最强自主智能体Claude Code平均21.5分，最强ResearchHarness LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均20.7分，LLM前沿均值仅26.5分。失败主要集中在实验方案不匹配、证据不匹配和缺失科学核心三个方面。
AI.conclusion: 当前自主科研系统距离可靠的目标论文级重新发现仍有很大差距。ResearchClawBench为衡量自主科学研究进展提供了可复现的评估基准。

title: Vessel Traffic Flow Prediction on Sparse Data via Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks with a Learnable Tweedie Head
summary: Accurate vessel traffic flow prediction is crucial for smart port operations and navigational safety. However, maritime traffic flow data are often highly sparse with intermittent bursts, making robust forecasting challenging. Under such conditions, conventional spatio-temporal graph neural networks (ST-GNNs) can degrade toward conservative near-zero predictions and fail to capture non-zero activity. Although zero-inflated negative binomial (ZINB) models partially address excess zeros, their two-part formulation can still remain conservative around abrupt transitions. To address these issues, we propose a model-agnostic learnable Tweedie head that can be attached as a plug-and-play output module to arbitrary ST-GNN backbones. Instead of likelihood-based Tweedie training, which typically requires surrogate objectives, our approach optimizes the closed-form Tweedie unit deviance and predicts the mean for point forecasting while learning a node-level variance power to capture heterogeneous variability across port areas. Experiments on a maritime traffic graph constructed from real-world AIS data in the Port of Los Angeles and Long Beach show that the proposed head consistently improves RMSE across multiple ST-GNN backbones, especially on non-zero events, leading to more reliable forecasts for practical maritime traffic control.

AI.tldr: 针对海事交通流数据的稀疏性和突发性导致传统时空图神经网络预测趋于保守的问题，提出了一种模型无关的可学习Tweedie输出头，作为即插即用模块附加到任意ST-GNN骨干网络，通过优化闭合形式的Tweedie单位偏差来预测均值并学习节点级方差幂，在洛杉矶长滩港真实AIS数据上显著提升了多骨干网络的RMSE，尤其对非零事件预测更可靠。
AI.motivation: 海事交通流数据具有高度稀疏性和间歇性突发特征，传统时空图神经网络在这种条件下会退化为保守的接近零的预测，无法捕捉非零活动。现有的零膨胀负二项模型虽部分解决了零膨胀问题，但其两部分公式在突变过渡处仍然保守，需要更有效的预测方法。
AI.method: 提出一种模型无关的可学习Tweedie输出头，作为即插即用模块附加到任意ST-GNN骨干网络。不采用通常需要代理目标的基于似然的Tweedie训练，而是优化闭合形式的Tweedie单位偏差，预测均值进行点预测，同时学习节点级方差幂以捕捉港口区域间的异质性变异性。
AI.result: 在基于洛杉矶长滩港真实AIS数据构建的海事交通图上，所提Tweedie头一致提升了多种ST-GNN骨干网络的RMSE，尤其在非零事件上效果显著，实现了更可靠的实际海事交通控制预测。
AI.conclusion: Tweedie输出头作为一种即插即用的模型无关模块，能有效解决海事交通流预测中数据稀疏和突发带来的保守预测问题，提升非零事件预测能力，适用于实际海事交通控制场景。

title: Parameter Tuning with Generalization Guarantees for GPU-Accelerated Linear Programming
summary: Recent research has developed practical, parallelizable first-order methods for large scale linear programming, but performance is highly dependent on hyperparameter selection. We derive generalization guarantees for hyperparameter tuning within (cu)PDLP, a state-of-the-art first-order LP solver designed for modern hardware. First, we pin down the behavior of PDHG, the primal-dual hybrid gradient algorithm that underlies PDLP, as a function of its step size and primal weight, leading to linear sample complexity guarantees for learning those parameters. We then conduct a structural analysis of PDLP, which augments PDHG with several specialized techniques like preconditioning, adaptive step sizes, averaging, adaptive restarts, and smoothed primal weight updates. Our analysis captures the behavior of the solution trajectory as a function of the hyperparameters and leverages recent advances in data-driven algorithm design to obtain polynomial sample complexity guarantees for learning those hyperparameters. Finally, we conduct proof-of-concept experiments that demonstrate the need for data-driven PDLP parameter tuning. Our results showcase the versatility of the data-driven algorithm design toolkit for principled hyperparameter tuning within solver-grade implementations of complex modern optimization algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文为(cu)PDLP这一先进一阶线性规划求解器的超参数调优提供了样本复杂度保证，通过分析PDHG算法行为及PDLP的复杂结构（预处理、自适应步长、平均化、自适应重启、平滑原始权重更新等），建立了线性/多项式样本复杂度保证，并通过实验验证了数据驱动调参的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有可并行化的一阶线性规划方法性能高度依赖超参数选择，但缺乏理论保证，本文旨在为求解器级别的复杂优化算法提供数据驱动超参数调优的理论基础。
AI.method: 首先刻画PDHG算法中步长和原始权重的行为并推导线性样本复杂度；然后对PDLP的多种增强技术（预处理、自适应步长、平均化、自适应重启、平滑原始权重更新）进行结构分析，利用数据驱动算法设计的最新进展获得多项式样本复杂度保证；最后进行概念验证实验。
AI.result: 获得了PDHG超参数学习的线性样本复杂度保证，以及PDLP完整超参数学习的多项式样本复杂度保证，实验验证了数据驱动调参的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 展示了数据驱动算法设计工具包在原则性超参数调优中的通用性，可应用于包含复杂现代优化算法的求解器级实现。

title: Contract2Tool: Learning Preconditions and Effects for Reliable Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented large language model agents increasingly rely on external APIs, but standard tool schemas describe how to call a tool, not when the tool is causally appropriate or what task state it produces. Causal tool filtering addresses this gap by using lightweight contracts that specify each tool's preconditions, effects, risk level, and cost. However, manually writing and maintaining such contracts does not scale to large or changing tool ecosystems. We introduce Contract2Tool, a framework for inferring tool contracts from metadata, schemas, documentation, and execution traces. Contract2Tool converts observable tool evidence into normalized symbolic contracts that can be evaluated intrinsically and deployed inside downstream causal tool filtering. We evaluate learned contracts against gold preconditions, effects, and risk labels, and measure their downstream utility on multi-step agent tasks. Our results show that hybrid documentation-and-trace evidence produces contracts accurate enough to preserve most of the reliability and efficiency benefits of gold contracts. Learned-contract CMTF achieves 0.980 downstream success, close to 0.990 for gold-contract CMTF, while reducing visible tools from 100 to 1 and reducing average token usage from 26,172 to 2,528 relative to all-tools exposure. These results suggest that learned contracts can provide a scalable contract layer between tool schemas and reliable agent execution.

AI.tldr: Contract2Tool框架能够从工具元数据、文档和执行轨迹中自动推断工具契约（前提条件、效果、风险等级和成本），通过学习到的契约进行因果工具过滤，在保持高任务成功率（0.980）的同时，将可见工具从100个减少到1个，Token使用从26,172降至2,528，接近黄金标准契约的性能（0.990）。
AI.motivation: 标准工具模式只描述如何调用工具，而不说明何时调用是因果适当的或产生什么任务状态。手动编写和维护工具契约在大规模或变化的工具生态中难以扩展，因此需要自动化的契约推断方法。
AI.method: Contract2Tool框架：从元数据、模式、文档和执行轨迹等可观测工具证据中，将信息转化为归一化的符号化契约，可进行内在评估并部署到下游因果工具过滤流程中。
AI.result: 混合文档与执行轨迹证据生成的契约足够准确，学习契约的CMTF下游成功率达0.980（黄金契约0.990），可见工具从100降至1，平均Token使用从26,172降至2,528。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的契约可以为工具模式与可靠智能体执行之间提供可扩展的契约层，在保持可靠性和效率优势的同时解决了手动扩展性问题。

title: UNIQ: Conformal Calibration for Adaptive Conservatism in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning requires careful conservatism to mitigate distribution shift, yet most existing methods apply a fixed penalty uniformly across all states regardless of local data coverage. We present UNIQ (Uncertainty-Informed Quantile), an offline RL method that introduces state-adaptive conservatism through conformally calibrated uncertainty estimation. Built on the Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) backbone, UNIQ trains a multi-expectile value ensemble, computes distribution-free uncertainty estimates using split conformal prediction, and maps the resulting signal to a state-dependent expectile that relaxes conservatism in well-covered regions while strengthening it in uncertain regions near the data frontier. On D4RL MuJoCo benchmarks, UNIQ consistently improves over IQL, with the largest gains observed on Walker2d and replay-heavy tasks. At the same time, UNIQ operates at near-IQL memory cost (approximately 250 MB peak VRAM), providing roughly a 10x reduction compared to EDAC. Rather than pursuing overall state-of-the-art performance, we position UNIQ as a practical mechanism contribution that improves the performance-efficiency trade-off in offline reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: UNIQ是一种基于不确定性量化实现状态自适应保守性的离线强化学习方法，通过在IQL基础上引入共形预测校准的不确定性估计，在数据覆盖好的区域放松保守性、在不确定区域加强保守性，在D4RL MuJoCo基准上持续优于IQL，同时保持近IQL的内存效率（约250MB），相比EDAC降低约10倍。
AI.motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法对保守性惩罚采用全局统一的固定强度，未能根据各状态局部数据覆盖情况自适应调整，导致在数据充足的区域过度保守、在数据稀疏区域保守性不足。
AI.method: 以Implicit Q-Learning为骨干，训练多分位数期望值（multi-expectile）价值集成网络；利用分割共形预测（split conformal prediction）计算无分布假设的不确定性估计；将不确定性信号映射为状态依赖的分位数期望值，实现保守性的自适应调节。
AI.result: 在D4RL MuJoCo基准上持续优于IQL，在Walker2d和重放类任务上提升最为显著；峰值显存约250MB，相比EDAC（约10倍）大幅降低内存开销。
AI.conclusion: UNIQ作为一项实用的机制贡献，在离线强化学习中改进了性能与效率之间的权衡，而非追求整体最先进性能。

title: A Framework for Evaluating and Benchmarking Concept Drift Detection Methods
summary: Data stream mining is fundamentally challenged by concept drift, where distributional changes can degrade model performance. Despite the proliferation of drift detection methods, progress in the field is hindered by inconsistent evaluation practices: studies rely on oversimplified synthetic data generators, adopt incompatible metrics, and lack transparency in hyperparameter selection, making fair comparisons difficult. We address this gap with a novel benchmarking framework comprising three contributions: (1) a drift simulation method that injects controlled distributional changes into real-world datasets via Monte Carlo trials, enabling supervised evaluation while preserving real-world data complexity; (2) an evaluation protocol for drift detection with timing-aware criteria, including the derivation of new metrics (e.g., F1 detection score, normalized detection time) that are comparable across streams; and (3) we advocate for a leave-one-dataset-out hyperparameter optimization protocol for drift detection methods that promotes configuration robustness across heterogeneous stream dynamics. We benchmark 14 widely used drift detection methods on 7 realworld datasets across 4 drift types (class prior, label swap, feature permutation, feature filtering), each under both abrupt and gradual transitions. Our experimental results provide insights into the strengths and weaknesses of current drift detection approaches while establishing baseline performance metrics for future research in this area. All code and experiments are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向数据流概念漂移检测的标准化基准框架，包含基于蒙特卡洛的真实数据漂移模拟方法、时序感知评估指标（如F1检测分数、归一化检测时间）以及留一数据集超参数优化协议，并在7个真实数据集上对14种漂移检测方法进行系统性评估。
AI.motivation: 当前概念漂移检测领域存在评估实践不一致的问题：过度依赖简化的合成数据生成器、采用不兼容的评估指标、超参数选择缺乏透明度，导致公平比较困难，亟需一个标准化基准框架来推动领域进展。
AI.method: (1) 基于蒙特卡洛试验的漂移模拟方法，向真实数据集中注入可控分布变化；(2) 时序感知的评估协议，推导了F1检测分数、归一化检测时间等新指标；(3) 留一数据集超参数优化协议，确保配置在不同数据流动态下的鲁棒性。在7个真实数据集、4种漂移类型（类先验、标签交换、特征排列、特征过滤）及急变/渐变两种过渡模式下评估14种方法。
AI.result: 建立了14种广泛使用的漂移检测方法在7个真实数据集上的性能基线，提供了当前方法在各类漂移场景下优缺点的系统 insights。
AI.conclusion: 该基准框架有效解决了漂移检测领域评估不一致的问题，所提出的标准化协议和指标为未来研究提供了可复现的比较基础，有助于推动该领域向更严谨的评估实践发展。

title: Explainable Optimization: A Call for Interdisciplinary Action
summary: Operations research and management science models support decisions that affect patients, workers, citizens, and public institutions. Decision-makers, such as clinicians approving surgical schedules, planners allocating disaster relief resources, or managers designing workforce rotations, increasingly require clear and actionable justifications that bridge the gap between mathematical optimization outputs and the intuitive reasoning stakeholders need to trust, contest, and implement recommended decisions. Yet the field has traditionally evaluated optimization models through computational criteria such as feasibility, optimality, scalability, and solution time, while treating explanation as a secondary concern. Mathematical transparency, provided through access to objectives, constraints, shadow prices, or sensitivity reports, does not automatically offer the forms of justification that stakeholders need to understand, trust, contest, or implement optimization-based decisions. This paper calls for the development of explainable optimization (XOpt) as a distinct interdisciplinary area that moves beyond algorithmic efficiency and incorporates behavioral, cognitive, and pragmatic perspectives to address this explanatory deficit.

AI.tldr: 本文呼吁将可解释优化（XOpt）发展为一个独立的跨学科领域，超越传统算法效率，整合行为、认知和实用主义视角，以弥合数学优化输出与利益相关者理解、信任、质疑和实施优化决策之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 运筹学与管理科学模型在医疗、救灾、人力资源等关键领域支持决策，但传统上仅通过可行性、最优性、可扩展性和求解时间等计算标准评估优化模型，将解释视为次要问题；数学透明度（如目标、约束、影子价格、敏感性报告）并不能自动提供利益相关者所需的理解、信任、质疑和实施优化决策的论证形式。
AI.method: 提出发展可解释优化（XOpt）作为独立跨学科领域，整合行为科学、认知科学和实用主义视角，以解决当前优化领域的解释性缺陷。
AI.result: 指出传统优化模型在解释性方面的不足，并论证了建立XOpt领域的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 运筹学与管理科学需要将可解释性作为核心关注点，发展XOpt这一跨学科领域，以提供利益相关者所需的、超越数学透明度的 actionable justification。

title: MemToolAgent overview with a simple restaurant booking scenario where the agent retrieves similar memories, receives feedback on an invalid time format, and generates a reflection to update its memory
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) agents can use external tools to help users solve complex tasks. However, for problems that require learning from long-term historical events or from previous agent-environment interactions, LLM agents are required to use memory mechanisms to store and retrieve experiences. While sophisticated memory systems exist for dialogue agents, few studies have empirically examined how to improve agents' tool-using capabilities through past user-agent conversations. We propose MemToolAgent, a framework that improves tool use through memory management. Our approach contains a memory extraction module that processes past experiences into structured memory entries, and a retrieval module that dynamically selects a subset of the stored memory entries. This enables more personalized and accurate responses aligned with user preferences and feedback without requiring LLM fine-tuning. In summary, this work has three main contributions: (1) a unified memory entry format that improves both general-purpose and personalized tool use without LLM fine-tuning, (2) a reflection-based memory extraction that uses environment and user feedback to distill wrong executions into critiques to store, and (3) a retrieval module that chooses how many past experiences to use based on the memory similarity distribution. MemToolAgent achieves 29%, 80%, and 17% relative improvements compared to strong baselines on the WorkBench, NESTFUL, and PEToolBench benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: MemToolAgent 是一个通过记忆管理提升大语言模型智能体工具使用能力的框架，包含记忆提取和检索模块，在三个基准测试上分别获得29%、80%和17%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在执行需要利用长期历史经验的任务时缺乏有效的记忆机制，尤其是在工具使用场景下，很少有研究系统性地探索如何通过过往用户-智能体对话来提升智能体的工具使用能力。
AI.method: 提出MemToolAgent框架，包含：(1) 统一的记忆条目格式，支持通用和个性化工具使用；(2) 基于反思的记忆提取模块，利用环境和用户反馈将错误执行转化为批评性记忆；(3) 基于记忆相似度分布的检索模块，动态选择适量的历史经验。
AI.result: 在WorkBench、NESTFUL和PEToolBench基准上分别比强基线方法提升29%、80%和17%。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调LLM即可通过结构化记忆管理实现更个性化、更准确的工具使用响应，有效对齐用户偏好和反馈。

title: Shortcuts in the Tail: Debiasing via Post-Hoc Spectral Compression of Fine-Tuning Updates
summary: Fine-tuning often introduces spurious correlations alongside task knowledge, causing systematic failures on underrepresented groups. Existing mitigations require retraining, group labels, or curated counterfactual data. We show a simple post-hoc intervention reduces shortcut reliance without any of these: truncating the tail of the SVD of $ΔW = W_\mathrm{ft} - W_\mathrm{base}$ reduces the spurious-group gap while preserving task accuracy. Across three instruction-tuned models ($0.5$B--$7$B) and four classification benchmarks, top-$k$ truncation reduces the gap on every cell at $<2$ pp accuracy loss, by up to $5\times$ on CivilComments. We propose this works because the shortcut response sits in the tail of the singular ordering of $ΔW$, a claim about how truncation behaves rather than about the raw singular values, which are broadly distributed and look the same across all four datasets. A controlled boundary case in which fine-tuning has only a shortcut to learn shows the predicted FT-to-base collapse, and bottom-/random-$k$ and matched-rank LoRA controls rule out generic low-rank approximation and rank-constrained training as the explanation. We read this as preliminary evidence that the singular basis of $ΔW$ is a useful coordinate system for studying what fine-tuning has learned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简单的事后干预方法——截断ΔW的SVD尾部——来减少微调引入的虚假关联，无需重训练、组标签或反事实数据。在多个模型和基准上，该方法以<2 pp的准确率损失，将虚假组差距降低最多5倍。
AI.motivation: 微调常引入虚假关联，导致在欠表征群体上系统性失败。现有缓解方法需要重训练、组标签或反事实数据，成本高昂。
AI.method: 对微调权重与基础权重的差值矩阵ΔW = W_ft - W_base进行奇异值分解（SVD），截断其尾部奇异值（top-k截断），实现事后干预。
AI.result: 在三个指令微调模型（0.5B-7B）和四个分类基准上，top-k截断在每个单元上均减少了虚假组差距，准确率损失<2 pp，在CivilComments上降低达5倍。对比实验（bottom-/random-k截断、匹配秩的LoRA）排除了通用低秩近似或秩约束训练的解释。
AI.conclusion: ΔW的奇异基是研究微调所学知识的有效坐标系；虚假关联往往位于ΔW的奇异值排序尾部，截断尾部可有效去偏。

title: Instrumented data for causal scientific machine learning
summary: Scientific machine learning is limited less by model size than by the data it is trained on. Observational data records what happened but not why; template synthetic data has a known generating process but only for the simulator's template, not the case a user faces. We argue a third option is now operationally feasible: instrumented data, in which every datum carries the mechanistic model that produced it, an explicit uncertainty over that model, and an executable family of counterfactuals. Verification-and-validation (V&V) instrumented image-to-simulation pipelines are one realisation: a sensor observation becomes a fully specified, solver-backed simulation with explicit, editable parameters and a propagated aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty. The substrate is case-specific, mechanistically supervised, and supports causal interventions through Pearl's do-operator. Near-term consequences for validation, auditing, and surrogate training span computational biology, climate, materials, fluid mechanics, and medical imaging; a longer-term, falsifiable implication concerns foundation models for scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"仪器化数据"（instrumented data）作为科学机器学习的第三种数据范式，每个数据点都携带其产生机制模型、明确不确定性及可执行的反事实族，并通过V&V仪器化图像到模拟流水线实现，旨在解决观测数据缺乏因果机制、模板合成数据缺乏案例特异性的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有科学机器学习受限于数据：观测数据记录结果但不记录原因，模板合成数据有已知生成过程但仅适用于模板而非用户面对的具体案例，缺乏兼具机制可解释性与案例特异性的数据范式。
AI.method: 提出"仪器化数据"范式，每个数据点包含：产生它的机制模型、对该模型的显式不确定性、可执行的反事实族。通过验证与确认（V&V）仪器化图像到模拟流水线实现：传感器观测转化为完全指定、求解器支持的仿真，具有显式可编辑参数和传播的偶然/认知不确定性。
AI.result: 该数据基底是案例特异性的、机制监督的，并支持通过Pearl的do-算子进行因果干预。在计算生物学、气候、材料、流体力学和医学成像等领域有验证、审计和代理训练方面的近期影响。
AI.conclusion: 仪器化数据在操作上已可行，其长期可证伪的启示涉及科学推理的基础模型，有望从根本上改变科学机器学习的数据范式。

title: OptMuon: Closed-Loop Orthogonalized Momentum Methods for Stochastic Optimization with Zero-Noise Optimality
summary: Orthogonalized momentum updates, as used in Muon-style optimizers, have recently shown strong empirical stability in large-scale deep learning. However, existing orthogonalized methods are typically paired with constant or open-loop magnitude rules, and therefore do not explicitly calibrate their update magnitudes from the observed optimization trajectory. Motivated by the closed-loop perspective behind Lipschitz-free and noise-adaptive methods, we propose OptMuon, a family of adaptive momentum orthogonalization methods for stochastic nonconvex optimization. OptMuon combines Muon-style polar-factor directions with a trajectory-dependent AdaGrad-Norm-type coefficient schedule, so that the update magnitude is determined by the observed gradient and momentum history rather than by a prescribed Lipschitz-dependent rule. The schedule does not use the smoothness constant, the variance level, or the bounded-gradient constant in parameter selection, and its running-maximum correction prevents isolated gradient spikes from causing excessive coefficient collapse. Under lower-boundedness, unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded variance, smoothness, and an almost-sure bounded stochastic-gradient condition, we prove two complementary guarantees. OptMuon-A achieves the noise-adaptive rate \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/2}T^{-1/4})\) under average smoothness, while OptMuon-I achieves \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/3}T^{-1/3})\) under individual smoothness. In the zero-noise regime, both bounds automatically reduce to a nearly optimal deterministic first-order rate \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2})\) without manual hyperparameter retuning. These results show that closed-loop scalar adaptation can be combined with Muon-style momentum orthogonalization while retaining noise adaptivity and zero-noise optimality up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OptMuon，一种将Muon风格动量正交化与闭环自适应标量系数调度相结合的自适应优化器族，在非凸随机优化中达到噪声自适应率，且在零噪声场景下自动收敛到近乎最优的确定率。
AI.motivation: 现有正交化动量方法（如Muon）通常使用常数或开环幅度规则，未能根据优化轨迹显式校准更新幅度。受Lipschitz-free和噪声自适应方法的闭环视角启发，作者希望将闭环自适应标量调节与动量正交化结合，以提升优化器的适应性和理论保证。
AI.method: OptMuon将Muon风格的极因子方向与轨迹依赖的AdaGrad-Norm型系数调度相结合。其系数调度不依赖光滑常数、方差水平或梯度有界常数，并通过运行最大修正防止梯度尖峰导致系数过度坍缩。OptMuon-A基于平均光滑性假设，OptMuon-I基于个体光滑性假设。
AI.result: OptMuon-A在平均光滑性下达到噪声自适应率\(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/2}T^{-1/4})\)；OptMuon-I在个体光滑性下达到\(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2}+σ^{1/3}T^{-1/3})\)。零噪声下两者均自动降至近乎最优的确定一阶率\(\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{-1/2})\)，无需手动调整超参数。
AI.conclusion: 闭环标量自适应可与Muon风格动量正交化有效结合，在保持噪声自适应性的同时，零噪声场景下达到对数因子内的最优性。

title: EditSR: Enhancing Neural Symbolic Regression via Edit-based Rectification
summary: Neural symbolic regression models improve inference efficiency by shifting structural search to pretraining, but their one-pass autoregressive decoding is prone to error accumulation, which may lead to generating structurally incorrect expressions, especially in complex expression generation scenarios. Existing rectification strategies can alleviate this issue, but they often depend on restarting global search, thereby weakening the efficiency advantage of neural models, and remain susceptible to error accumulation. In this paper, we propose EditSR, a two-layer framework that combines a neural symbolic regression model in the first layer with an edit-based Rectifier in the second layer to achieve efficient prediction and post-hoc rectification. Instead of restarting the global search, we maintain rectification efficiency by pretraining the Rectifier. Specifically, we formulate the rectification process as a step-by-step state-transition chain starting from an incorrect expression, and develop a state-transition algorithm to construct supervised rectification chains for training the Rectifier. To ensure syntactic validity throughout rectification, each edit action is restricted to a syntactically valid space so that every edited expression remains parseable. In addition, because each edit decision is conditioned on the current state rather than the history, the Rectifier allows errors made in earlier steps to be rectified by subsequent edits, thereby reducing the risk of error accumulation. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that EditSR substantially improves symbolic structure recovery with limited extra cost, with more pronounced gains on complex expressions, where one-pass autoregressive decoding is more susceptible to error accumulation.

AI.tldr: EditSR 是一个双层框架，结合了第一层的神经符号回归模型与第二层的基于编辑的修正器，通过预训练修正器实现高效的逐状态修正，避免重启全局搜索，并限制编辑操作在语法有效空间内以确保句法有效性，从而显著提升符号结构恢复能力，尤其适用于复杂表达式。
AI.motivation: 神经符号回归模型通过将结构搜索转移到预训练中来提升推理效率，但其自回归解码容易产生误差累积，导致生成结构不正确的表达式，尤其在复杂表达式场景中更为严重。现有修正策略通常依赖重启全局搜索，削弱了神经模型的效率优势，且仍受误差累积影响。
AI.method: 提出 EditSR 双层框架：第一层为神经符号回归模型，负责高效预测；第二层为基于编辑的修正器（Rectifier）。将修正过程建模为从错误表达式开始的逐步状态转移链，设计状态转移算法构建监督修正链以训练修正器。每个编辑操作限制在语法有效空间内，确保编辑后的表达式可解析。编辑决策仅基于当前状态而非历史，允许后续编辑纠正前期错误。
AI.result: 大量实验和消融研究表明，EditSR 以有限的额外计算成本显著提升了符号结构恢复能力，在复杂表达式（自回归解码更易产生误差累积的场景）上的增益尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过将修正过程解耦为逐状态编辑而非重启全局搜索，EditSR 在保持神经模型效率优势的同时有效缓解了误差累积问题，为神经符号回归中的后修正提供了高效且有效的解决方案。

title: Repetition Mismatch: Why Data Mixture Experiments Don't Scale and How to Fix Them
summary: Pre-training data mixtures are commonly tuned by running small-scale experiments and extrapolating to the target training budget. When high-quality data is scarce and must be repeated, this extrapolation frequently fails, but the source of the failure has not been isolated. We show that a primary culprit is a repetition mismatch: because high-quality datasets are small, their repetition rate changes as the training budget grows, shifting the optimal mixture in ways that small-scale proxy experiments do not anticipate. A subsampling procedure that matches the target repetition rate controls for this effect. In a two-source setting combining limited high-quality data with web crawl, a single repetition-controlled experiment using only 1/16 of the target tokens recovers a mixture within 0.05 of the optimum for a 757M parameter model, compared to an error of 0.75 without repetition control. Achieving comparable accuracy without repetition control requires three to four horizons, consuming 44 to 94% of the target token budget. With three data sources, the larger mixture space requires more than a single experiment to constrain, but the approach remains effective: at the 757M scale, just two repetition-controlled horizons recover the optimal mixture, outperforming baselines that instead require the full two-source experiments to construct. Our results reveal that repetition dynamics, not scale alone, shape whether small-scale mixture experiments generalize. More broadly, they suggest that data repetition deserves treatment as a first-class variable in mixture optimization, rather than an inconvenient side effect of limited data.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了预训练数据混合中重复率不匹配是导致小规模实验外推失败的主要原因，并提出通过子采样控制重复率的方法，在仅使用1/16目标token的条件下即可接近最优混合比例。
AI.motivation: 高质量数据稀缺时需重复使用，但小规模实验的混合比例无法推广到更大训练预算，其失败根源尚未被明确识别。
AI.method: 通过子采样过程匹配目标重复率来控制重复效应；在双源和三源数据设置下，使用重复控制的少步长实验搜索最优混合比例。
AI.result: 双源场景下，1/16 token的重复控制实验误差仅0.05（无控制时为0.75）；三源场景下，两个重复控制步长即可恢复最优混合，优于需完整双源实验的基线。
AI.conclusion: 重复动态而非规模本身决定了小样本混合实验的泛化能力；数据重复应被作为混合优化的第一类变量，而非不便的副作用。

title: Partially Performative Prediction
summary: Performative prediction studies feedback loops that arise when predictive models are deployed in consequential domains.
